title: Partner Development Manager
description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises and public sector organizations are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we're committed to transforming the enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for Germany and the DACH Region focused on the Public Sector & Enterprise Market, you'll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses and government entities across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You'll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, technology partners, and public sector organizations to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of businesses and government agencies. Your work will directly contribute to our success. You'll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation in both commercial and public sectors, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the AI ecosystem. If you're a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world's most dynamic markets including the public sector, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI. Key Responsibilities Partner Strategy & Execution Define and execute Cohere's partner go-to-market plan for the Enterprise & Public Sector Market, aligning with regional business objectives. Partner with the broader GTM team to identify and recruit high-impact partners across system integrators, distributors, resellers, ISVs, cloud providers, and public sector consultancy firms. Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem, including government agencies, municipalities, and public sector institutions, to ensure partnership success. Partner Onboarding & Enablement Lead partner onboarding, certification, and training programs to ensure partners are equipped to sell, deploy and manage Cohere's solutions effectively for both commercial and public sector customers. Collaborate with enablement to scale partner enablement through sales and technical workshops, empowering them to deliver value to enterprise customers and government agencies. Pipeline Generation & Co-Selling Own joint pipeline generation by creating co-sell motions, solution plays, and strategic joint go-to market motions that align Cohere's capabilities with enterprise mission needs and public sector procurement cycles. Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue high-value opportunities in both commercial and government contracts. Business Planning & Performance Tracking Ensure partners are aligned with Cohere's strategic goals and performance metrics, including public sector compliance and reporting requirements. Run joint business planning sessions and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with partners, tracking sourced and influenced ARR against targets. Partner Advocacy & Feedback Serve as the voice of the partner within Cohere, relaying feedback to Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Work with Cohere's Public Policy teams to navigate government AI policies and regulations to advise partners on risk management and responsible AI best practices for the public sector. Thought Leadership & Evangelism Evangelize Cohere's vision and solutions at partner and industry events, positioning Cohere as a leader in responsible GenAI for both commercial and public sector markets. Build thought leadership through briefings, speaking engagements, and collaborative initiatives focused on AI in government and public services. Why You'll Love This Role This is a high-impact role where you'll shape the future of AI partnerships in both commercial and public sectors. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business, and policy, driving growth while ensuring responsible AI adoption across enterprises and government organizations. If you're passionate about building strategic alliances, driving innovation, and making a difference in one of the world's most dynamic markets including the public sector, this is the role for you. What We're Looking For 8+ years of experience in partner development, channel sales, or alliance management within the tech industry, preferably in AI or cloud solutions, with a track record of enterprise ARR contribution and public sector partnerships. Deep understanding of public sector organizations, government agencies, and municipal institutions, plus the enterprise market and key industry verticals. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of driving partner success in both commercial and public sector environments. Experience and demonstrated depth with Sovereign Cloud GTM. Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes, including AI ethics, government policies, and public sector procurement requirements. Working understanding of AI (LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows) and their applications in enterprise and public sector contexts. Experience working with major system integrators, global consultancies, hyperscalers, and public sector technology partners including joint GTM and co-sell motions. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to evangelize Cohere's vision to partners, government stakeholders, and industry organizations. Results-driven growth mindset and bias for action. You thrive in a start-up-speed environment and enjoy building and scaling partner programs across commercial and public sectors. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and wants to make a meaningful impact on how AI transforms both businesses and public services. The Berlin location provides access to a vibrant tech ecosystem with strong connections to European public sector initiatives and government partnerships. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. B. title: Senior Customer Success Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach! Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen. Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen. Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes? Qualifikation Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Erfahrung mit großen Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf. Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren großen Kunden den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen. Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil. Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit). Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung. Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert. Alternativ erstatten wir dir dein Deutschlandticket. Wir verstehen, dass das Leben flexibel sein muss. Daher bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit 2 Tagen Home-Office pro Woche in einer geregelten 5-Tage-Woche. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Dienstwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung, um dich bei Kundenterminen und Reisen optimal zu unterstützen. Du hast 27 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit. title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team. Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers Who you are We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel. Typically, your profile will look like this: Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it What makes this exciting You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What the process will look like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage: Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics Offer, contract signing and onboarding Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. The challenge There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible. What this role could turn into Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. title: UX Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.</span></p></div><p>Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric air taxi. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org is building consumer software for people who love to fly: mobile apps, websites, and web apps for flyers, flight enthusiasts, and pilots. We haven't announced what we're building, and we're not going to spoil it in a job posting. What we can tell you: it's a consumer app with a large user base, and the design decisions made in the next year will define the next chapter of growth for the product.</p> <p>That's why we're hiring a UX Product Designer; specifically, someone who has shipped consumer apps that real people download, rate, and decide to keep or delete, and who can take a loosely defined problem and come back with something worth building.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-end product design for consumer aviation apps on iOS and Android, along with the websites and web apps that support them</li> <li>Design for a wide range of users, from casual flyers and aviation enthusiasts to working pilots who need information that's fast, accurate, and trustworthy</li> <li>Run product explorations: sketch out directions, pressure-test them with users and the team, and kill the weak ones early</li> <li>You'll get context and constraints from Design Leadership, PM and engineering, but the design leadership on your projects is yours</li> <li>Ship to the App Store and Google Play, then keep refining based on how people actually use what you shipped: analytics, experiments, reviews, and user research</li> <li>Raise the bar on craft across the org, through your own work and through feedback on everyone else's</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product design experience minimum. </li> <li>A track record of shipping features for consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, ideally at a startup, a big tech company, or both</li> <li>Products you've designed that are live and in users' hands. We will ask about them, in detail: what you decided, what you got wrong, what you'd change</li> <li>Deep fluency in native iOS and Android design (Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design) and strong systems thinking across mobile and web. You know when a pattern should be shared across platforms and when it shouldn't</li> <li>Experience using data to shape design decisions, from engagement and retention metrics to App Store feedback</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. If you need a fully scoped ticket before you can start, this won't be a fit</li> <li>A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just polished final screens</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're a pilot, student pilot, plane spotter, or all-around aviation nerd. You'd be designing for people like you, and that matters</li> <li>Experience designing consumer apps built around real-time data, maps, or location</li> <li>Experience growing a consumer app: onboarding, retention, subscriptions, or monetization, social posting and marketing collateral</li> <li>Experience working alongside AI/ML teams, or designing products with AI-driven features</li> <li>You've shipped consumer products in a domain with real-world constraints (regulated industries, safety-adjacent, hardware-adjacent) and know how that shapes design</li> </ul> <p><strong>About The Team:</strong></p> <p>AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the product development startup culture of a smaller team based in the UK – building for an audience that genuinely cares about flying.</p> <p>If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. Apply, and we'll tell you plenty.</p> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs. Applicants who may require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should provide their name and contact information to Archer’s People Team at <a ----- ----- Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis.</span></h5> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Archer's <a href="https://archer.com/legal/personnel-candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy</a>.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Certain positions may be eligible for visa sponsorship.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer Aviation does not engage with external recruiting agencies/individual recruiters with whom it does not have a prior written agreement. Archer reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes that it receives and bears no responsibility for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes. If you are a recruiting agency or individual recruiter wishing to do business with Archer, please reach out to <a ----- ----- All employment processes are managed by the Archer People Team.</span></h5></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: DSP Engineer - Werkstudent
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe. As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild. You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p><strong>Work Location: </strong>This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Team Lead</p> <ul> <li>Help prototype, implement, and test DSP algorithms in Python and C++.</li> <li>Analyze recorded RF / I/Q captures and help characterize drone and controller signals.</li> <li>Build and improve scripts and tooling for signal analysis, data handling, and visualization.</li> <li>Run experiments and document results to support detection and classification work.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.</li> <li>Coursework or project experience in DSP fundamentals (e.g., sampling, filtering, FFT/spectral analysis, modulation).</li> <li>Programming experience in Python and/or C++.</li> <li>Genuine curiosity about RF / wireless and signal processing, and an eagerness to learn on real data.</li> <li>Good communication skills in English; German is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. title: Senior Manager, Product Design - Security
description: <p>The Datadog Security design team (K9 Design, as we lovingly call it) is hiring a senior product design manager to lead design across our security products. This is a chance to shape an industry-leading experience for a new kind of Datadog user: security practitioners who need to catch threats where they start, stop them when they land, and shut down exposures before they turn into something worse.</p> <p>You'll lead a team of designers at various stages of their careers across cloud, code and data security, turning an overwhelming amount of signal into something a security team can act on. The goal: build the security product people want to spend their day in. You'll own the design, push for excellence, and partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to get there.</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true">At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li>Lead design direction across your team's products, and hold the bar for design excellence end to end: interactions, visual detail, consistency and cohesion.</li> <li>You're in the work. Run critiques, give direct and useful feedback, and push the team toward bolder, more opinionated solutions rather than safe ones.</li> <li>Coach and grow designers across our Paris, Madrid and New York offices, helping each of them do the best work of their careers.</li> <li>Help define a security design system built on top of Datadog's existing components, with the security practitioner's workflows in mind.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to evolve cross-platform thinking, shape roadmaps, and to set how the three disciplines work together day to day.</li> <li>Take accountability for the product and business outcomes your team's design work influences.</li> <li>Bring AI fluency to how your team works, from how design gets explored and validated to how it gets shipped.</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <ul> <li>10+ years in design, including experience leading and growing high-performing teams.</li> <li>A design leader first: a user advocate with a sharp eye for detail, strong taste and the willingness to get into the work and give direct feedback.</li> <li>A track record of leveling up a team's output, with before-and-after examples of how your leadership transformed the design of a product.</li> <li>You've led complex products or features: a zero-to-one launch, a reimagining of something established, or both.</li> <li>A strong communicator who collaborates effectively with executive and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Able to demonstrate AI fluency, either in your own work or in how you've led teams through it.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating the technical complexity of modern software development and cloud infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Ideally</strong>: security domain experience, or a portfolio of information-dense, data-rich interfaces. Industry-leading work on complex B2B, B2C or consumer products counts for just as much here.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits and Growth</h2> <ul> <li>Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space</li> <li>Continuous career development and pathing opportunities for internal mobility</li> <li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan</li> <li>Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Generous global benefits</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on <a href="https://www.instagram.com/datadoghq/?hl=en" target="_blank">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/datadog" target="_blank">LinkedIn,</a> and <a href="https://learn.datadoghq.com/" target="_blank">Datadog Learning Center. </a></p> <hr> <p data-renderer-start-pos="215"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Equal Opportunity at Datadog:</strong></p> <p>Datadog is proud to offer <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">equal employment opportunity</a> to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Commercial Account Executive (Italy)
description: <p><strong>Commercial Account Executive</strong></p> <p>As an Account Executive (AE) on our Commercial Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across small to midsize markets. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. title: Turkey Content Specialist
description: Role Overview We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Turkey (and keep it there). You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Turkey into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app. If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading. You are: Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative. A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off. Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly. Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better. Deeply tuned into Turkish memes, humour, and online culture. Fluent in Turkish and lived in Turkey. Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team. Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented. What You’ll Do: Grow Bump in Turkey (yep, you'll actually own this). Lead all content + creator efforts for the Turkish market. Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch. Build and manage a pipeline of Turkish creators. Run influencer campaigns with top Turkish creators and micro-influencers. Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance. Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page. Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine. Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product. Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump. Support launches, events, and Turkey-focused activations. Requirements: 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title). Experience making content for ads (UGC especially). Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback. Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Turkish creator landscape. Turkish language and English language proficiency. Experience living in Turkey. Must be willing to work in person in Paris. Why Join Bump? Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast. Own the entire Turkish market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps. Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth. Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try. Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in Turkey. We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly. title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable. This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate. Key Responsibilities: • Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release • Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals • Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls • Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams • Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD) • Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification • Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics • Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices Skills and Experience Required: • BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory • Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems • Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061) • Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering • Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures • Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus • Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts • Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus • Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus Start date: Immediately Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Purpose of the role As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co , our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself. Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster. Key responsibilities Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are We’re looking for Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest. Nice to have CircleCI or a similar CI tool Working with an external testing partner Payments, checkout or ticketing systems Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it. We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music. We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community. We honour the past, present and future of electronic music. We use innovation to empower the community. We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit. We're always front left. title: Business Development Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will: </p> <ul> <li>Create excellent customer experiences</li> <li>Learn customer-centric sales skills</li> <li>Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product</li> <li>Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations</li> </ul> <p>Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare</p> <ul> <li>Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue</li> <li>Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads</li> <li>Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)</li> <li>Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC</li> <li>Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes</li> </ul> <p>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working as a BDR in a similar capacity in technology industry in the META region (experience in SaaS will be a plus)</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Ability to work as part of a team or independently</li> <li>Analytical, organization and time management skills</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills</li> <li>Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity</li> <li>Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously</li> <li>Experience in Outreach and Salesforce is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Customer Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>What is the Role</strong></p> <p>We are actively seeking a Customer Architect with an understanding of technology and hands-on experience in key IT domains, notably Observability, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Search. You should possess a strong technical background, preferably with experience in cloud-based software solutions. </p> <p>We value individuals who are passionate about staying at the forefront of technology trends with a growth mindset and excited to learn and implement new technologies. While previous experience with Elastic solutions is not a prerequisite, an eagerness to adopt our suite of solutions and apply them effectively to solve our customers' challenges is critical. This key role involves not only driving the consumption of our Elastic solutions by aligning them with customer business objectives but also onboarding customers, securing adoption, and facilitating expansion. </p> <p>As a Customer Architect, you will be the Trusted Technical Advisor, working in tandem with the customer and complementary groups like Field and Services Teams to ensure that Elastic solutions are exceeding customer’s expectations. . Your technical expertise, eye for business, and ability to deliver value will accelerate and improve the customer experience leading to customer continued satisfaction and expansion within the elastic portfolio. </p> <p>In your role, a crucial part of your responsibility is defining and communicating the technical success criteria for our customers. This involves crafting detailed Technical Success Plans tailored to the specific customers goals and critical metrics.</p> <p>The Technical Success Plans act as a roadmap, outlining the optimal consumption and deployment of Elastic solutions in the customer's environment. They detail the necessary steps for implementation, highlight achievements for successful consumption or expansion, and provide and effectiveness aligned to the customer’s business goals. By actioning this plan , you will be seen as the trusted advisor, guiding the customer towards achieving their desired outcomes, thereby ensuring their success and satisfaction.</p> <p>From providing technical guidance and sharing standard methodologies to aligning technical objectives with the customers' business goals, your work is instrumental in facilitating smooth adoption, sustained usage, and increased consumption of our solutions. This hands-on role requires you to be proactive, with a keen understanding of our customers' technical landscape and a commitment to making their journey with Elastic solutions successful and valuable.</p> <p>Your chief aim will be to ensure the customer derives significant value, eliminate technical frictions, and propel the uptake and application of Elastic solutions, with the ultimate title: Staff Software Engineer
description: <p>OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.</p> <p>We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before. We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit <a href="https://www.oag.com/">www.oag.com</a><br><br></p> <div class="jss-po-ats-3-250 jss-po-ats-3-252"> <div class="mce-content-body"> <p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE:</strong></p> <p>OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.</p> <p>This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.</p> <p>You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.</p> <p>The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.</p> <p>This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.<br><br></p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built</li> <li>Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several</li> <li>Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool</li> <li>Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long</li> <li>Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer</li> <li>Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. This includes making AI-assisted development reliable, with the checks needed to keep quality high</li> <li>Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience<strong> building and running production software end to end</strong>, from system design through to operating it live</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership</strong> beyond a single team: a track record of influencing engineers and teams you don’t manage, and building agreement across them</li> <li><strong>System design across boundaries</strong>: systems that stay correct, fast and affordable when several teams, several delivery channels and a shared data platform are all involved, and sound judgement on when to solve something once centrally versus letting each team solve it</li> <li>Hands-on experience in analytical or data-intensive contexts and depth in <strong>large-scale data platforms</strong>: how they’re built, governed and paid for, including keeping one customer’s data separate from another’s, controlling access at the data layer, tracking data lineage, and keeping query cost under control</li> <li><span data-teams="true"><strong>Machine learning and AI in production:</strong> enough understanding of how models and agents are built, trained and evaluated to set the technical brief for the data science team, read an evaluation critically, and judge whether a result will hold up in the real world. Experience taking AI-powered features into production and making them reliable, cost-effective and trustworthy for customers.</span></li> <li>Judgement under uncertainty, with commercial awareness: you understand that technical choices affect what the business can charge and what it costs to serve a customer, and you know when to decide and when to wait</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator </strong>who can explain direction, risk and trade-offs so that engineers, product, commercial and senior leaders all take away the same thing</li> <li><strong>A builder’s mindset</strong>. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships</li> <li><strong>AI-native </strong>in how you build: you use AI tooling with judgement, stay current with how agentic development is evolving, and help make effective agentic practices the norm across the team</li> </ul> <p>If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.<br><br></p> <p><strong>WE WILL OFFER YOU</strong></p> <p>🚀      A progressive, non-hierarchical culture where innovation drives everything we build </p> <p>🏡      Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance </p> <p>💰      An attractive compensation and benefits package, including access to a Simplyhealth cash plan to support your everyday health and wellbeing, a company bonus scheme, Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme and enhanced pension scheme</p> <p>🏖️      25 days holiday plus bank holidays, volunteering days and additional day off during your birthday month</p> <p>👪      Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys</p> <p>🌍      Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year </p> <p>📚      Annual learning and development budget. <br>      <br>OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.</p> <p>We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.</p> </div> </div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><div class="page"> <div class="layoutArea"> <div class="column"> <p>Du hast Lust strategische Influencer-Kampagnen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen und möchtest mehr „Purpose“ mit deiner Arbeit bewirken, indem du Marken und Unternehmen strategisch mit gesellschaftlich relevanten Themen verknüpfst? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig: „We inspire brands and people to impact the world“ – Ogilvys Vision ist es, Marken und Menschen dafür zu begeistern, die Welt zu verändern. Diese Vision treibt auch uns bei Ogilvy Public Relations an. </p> <p>Unsere Kommunikations-Allrounder beraten Kunden in den Bereichen Corporate, BtC und BtB Communications sowie Social Media, Influencer und Content Marketing. Was uns ausmacht: Tiefe Marken- und Unternehmenskenntnisse, Leidenschaft für kreative Kommunikation und die Maxime “We, not me”. </p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir also <strong>eine:n <span data-teams="true">Senior Influence Manager </span>(m/w/d) </strong>in Düsseldorf oder Berlin. </p> <p><strong>Das bieten wir: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (drei Präsenztage vor Ort) </li> <li>Nutzung unseres WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning </li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen </li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen </li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes </li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr </li> <li>Zugriff auf unser Employee Assistance Programm TELUS Health </li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der Headspace-App </li> <li>Subventionierte Gympass-Mitgliedschaft </li> </ul> <p><strong>Deine Aufgaben:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operative Steuerung unserer Influencer-Kampagnen, von der Konzeption und Umsetzung bis hin zur Überwachung und dem Projektcontrolling</li> <li>Entwicklung von Influencer-Strategien inklusive der Empfehlung von Zielsetzungen, Zielgruppen, Redaktionskalendern und Budgets.</li> <li>Du entwickelst Strategien nicht nur, sondern setzt sie auch eigenverantwortlich und operativ selbst um – von der Konzeption bis zur täglichen Kampagnensteuerung.</li> <li>Recherche, Aufbereitung, Präsentation und Ansprache relevanter Influencer für die Kampagnen</li> <li>Budgetcontrolling der Influencer-Kampagnen</li> <li>Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern - intern und extern - um für unsere Kund:innen passende Kampagnen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen</li> <li>Weiterentwicklung und Verwaltung unserer Influencer-Datenbank</li> <li>Kundenbindung und -zufriedenheit sowie Qualitätssicherung der Agenturleistungen</li> <li>Auswertung, Analyse und Reporting von Influencer-Kampagnen</li> </ul> <p><strong>Was du mitbringst:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du bist ein Talent, möchtest den Quereinstieg wagen und hast anschauliche Beispiele uns das zu präsentieren oder du hast 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Influencer Marketing und kennst dich bestens in der deutschen Creator Szene aus</li> <li>Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in den Bereichen Konzeption, Kampagnenplanung und -durchführung, Influencer Relations, Events, Social Media und Projektmanagement</li> <li>Umfassende Kenntnisse und Kontakte im Bereich Influencer Relations</li> <li>Du hast eine hohe Affinität für aktuelle Trends und bist am Puls der Zeit bei cultural und social Themen. </li> <li>Präsentationsstärke: Fähigkeit, kreative Ideen vor internen Stakeholdern sowie bestehenden und potenziellen Neukunden sicher zu präsentieren</li> <li>Du bist Teamplayer, besitzt eine hohe Kundenorientierung und Qualitätsanspruch sind für dich selbstverständlich</li> <li>Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrungen mit Influencer Recherche- und Analyse-Tools</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. Den Herausforderungen der heutigen Welt können wir nur gemeinsam begegnen. Wir verpflichten uns daher, für den Job in Frage kommende Bewerber:innen ausschließlich nach ihren Fähigkeiten und grundsätzlich unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion zu beurteilen.</p> <p>Das klingt nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Sehr gut, dein Ansprechpartner Kai Schlüter freut sich über deine Bewerbung!<br>Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit und des Datenschutzes bitten wir darum, Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über unsere Bewerber:innenplattform Greenhouse an uns zu senden. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auf das Mitsenden eines Fotos verzichtet würde.</p> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Accounting intern - Paris
description: <p><strong>Qui sommes-nous?</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une nouvelle génération de cabinet de conseil spécialisée en Data dont plus de 2500 collaborateurs répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission d’accompagner la transformation chez nos clients.</p> <p>Nous offrons une large gamme de solutions data-driven, que nous adaptions aux besoins spécifiques de nos clients, que ce soit des projets IA pour l'automatisation des process internes à chaque étape de leur chaîne de valeur, la création d'expériences consommateurs innovantes et personnalisées, le conseil en stratégie data et marketing digital jusqu'à la gestion du mix-média et plus encore !</p> <p>La performance de nos services data repose sur une réelle expertise technologique en Intelligence Artificielle et des compétences métiers acquises auprès de plus de 1000 clients dans le monde, tels que Orange, Carrefour, Engie, Emirates, Deutsche Telekom, Monoprix… </p> <p>La force d'Artefact repose sur un mix unique d'atouts: une connaissance des technologies de pointe en data, des méthodes agiles permettant de délivrer très rapidement les projets et des équipes composées des meilleurs experts dans leurs domaines (business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, ingénieurs data…).</p> <p>Dans ce contexte, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) stagiaire Assistant Comptable pour rejoindre notre équipe finance en<strong> janvier 2027</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Missions : </strong></p> <p>Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Comptable France, vous assurez la gestion de l’état administratif financier de l’entreprise.</p> <p>De ce fait, vous contribuerez avec l’équipe finance France à :</p> <p><strong>Factures fournisseurs :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collecter les factures et informations manquantes auprès des fournisseurs et équipes métiers</li> <li>Contrôler les factures dès leur réception,</li> <li>Valider ces dernières auprès des différentes équipes,</li> <li>Saisir les factures fournisseurs dans le logiciel Sage,</li> <li>Mettre à jour et contrôler les codes analytiques des écritures comptables</li> <li>Analyser les comptes fournisseurs (lettrages, justifications des soldes)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note de Frais :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contrôler et valider les notes de frais, </li> <li>Les intégrer dans Sage</li> </ul> <p><strong>Divers :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Participer à l’amélioration des outils de gestion (Yooz, Sage 1000, Reporting BI…)</li> <li>Réaliser diverses tâches administratives,</li> <li>Aider à la préparation de la clôture semestrielle</li> </ul> <p>La variété des diverses tâches qui vous seront attribuées vous permettra d'enrichir vos connaissances et de contribuer à l’amélioration de notre service</p> <p><strong>Profil : </strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous préparez un diplôme dans le domaine de la gestion, comptabilité, contrôle, audit, finance et  vous justifiez idéalement d’une première expérience professionnelle (en stage par exemple) sur un poste similaire.</li> <li>Vous maîtrisez les techniques comptables et les logiciels informatiques du métier (Idéalement Sage, le pack office). </li> <li>Organisé, enthousiaste, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre énergie, votre autonomie et votre sens de responsabilité.</li> <li>Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe et vous êtes à l’aise en communication, tant orale qu’écrite.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salaire : </strong>1200€ brut / mois </p> <p><strong>Processus de Recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien RH</li> <li>Entretien avec le Responsable comptable France</li> <li>Entretien DAF France</li> </ul> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.</em></p> <p><strong>Come join us!</strong></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><h2>About InDomo</h2> <p>InDomo is a WPP company and the trusted transformation partner for multinationals ready to unlock rapid digital business growth. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with marketing leaders to build bespoke, in-house performance marketing capabilities that break down silos, put the consumer at the centre, and drive measurable commercial impact.</p> <p>In 2026, our focus has sharpened around AI-powered marketing transformation. We help brands navigate the shift to an AI-driven world by designing new ways of working, deploying intelligent marketing agents, and leveraging WPP Open (WPP’s proprietary AI platform) to deliver breakthrough results. We are scaling our AI practice rapidly and looking for a sharp, motivated intern to join the team and contribute from day one.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is not a coffee-and-PowerPoint internship. As our AI & Marketing Transformation Intern, you will be embedded in a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You’ll support real client engagements, help build AI-powered solutions, and contribute to shaping how some of the world’s biggest brands adopt AI in their marketing.</p> <p>You’ll be given real responsibility, direct access to senior team members, and the opportunity to develop skills that sit at the cutting edge of where marketing is heading. If you’re finishing a Master’s programme and want to hit the ground running in AI-driven marketing transformation, this is the role.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <h3>AI Agent Development Support</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the design, testing, and iteration of custom AI expert agents for enterprise marketing clients.</li> <li>Help build and refine AI-powered workflows using WPP Open and adjacent tooling, working alongside senior team members.</li> <li>Research and experiment with AI tools, techniques, and frameworks (such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and API integrations) to support solution development.</li> <li>Document agent performance, capture learnings, and contribute to our internal knowledge base.</li> </ul> <h3>Workshops & Client Engagement</h3> <ul> <li>Support the preparation and delivery of AI Discovery Workshops and transformation sessions for senior marketing leaders.</li> <li>Help develop workshop materials, including diagnostic frameworks, interactive exercises, and output templates.</li> <li>Attend and contribute to client meetings, with the opportunity to present specific sections or findings as your confidence grows.</li> <li>Support the delivery of internal training and enablement sessions on AI tools and ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Go-to-Market & Research</h3> <ul> <li>Help develop pitch decks, case studies, proposals, and other sales collateral for new business development.</li> <li>Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep our AI propositions sharp and well-positioned.</li> <li>Contribute to the packaging and refinement of InDomo’s AI service offerings.</li> </ul> <h3>Platform & Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Become proficient in WPP Open, exploring new features and capabilities and sharing findings with the team.</li> <li>Stay on top of the rapidly evolving AI and marketing technology landscape, surfacing relevant tools, trends, and opportunities.</li> <li>Bring fresh thinking. We value your perspective as someone close to the latest academic research and emerging ideas.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <h3>Must-Haves</h3> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Strategy, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline.</li> <li>A genuine, demonstrable interest in AI and its application to marketing or business. You’ve explored AI tools beyond the basics and can talk about what you’ve learned.</li> <li>Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills. You can take a complex topic, break it down, and communicate it clearly.</li> <li>Confident communicator who is comfortable presenting ideas to a room, whether that’s a team meeting or a client session.</li> <li>Excellent written and visual communication. You can structure a compelling deck or write a clear, persuasive brief.</li> <li>Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, work independently when needed, and don’t wait to be told what to do.</li> <li>Available for a full-time, 6-month internship based in Amsterdam.</li> </ul> <h3>Strong Pluses</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with AI tools in an academic or personal project context, such as building chatbots, experimenting with LLMs, using AI coding assistants, or working with APIs.</li> <li>Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agent architectures.</li> <li>Previous internship or work experience in marketing, consulting, or a technology-related field.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise platforms (e.g., CRM systems, marketing automation tools, or analytics platforms).</li> <li>Familiarity with Dutch and/or international market dynamics.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Offer</h2> <p>As part of the WPP network, you’ll have access to a world-class professional environment and a comprehensive set of benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Real, meaningful work on live client engagements with some of the world’s biggest brands. No busywork.</li> <li>Direct mentorship from experienced AI and marketing transformation leaders.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with WPP Open and cutting-edge AI tooling that most people only read about.</li> <li>A competitive internship compensation.</li> <li>Access to WPP’s global learning resources and professional development programmes.</li> <li>Light, open-plan office space with roof terrace, on-site bar, and stunning views over central Amsterdam.</li> <li>This role is based at WPP Amsteldok Amsterdam and requires 3–4 days of on-site work, with the flexibility to work remotely 1–2 days a week.</li> <li>A strong foundation for a career in one of the fastest-growing areas in marketing. High-performing interns may be considered for permanent roles.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics.
