title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,  a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure: </strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.</li> <li>Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.</li> <li>Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will thrive in this role if you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.</li> <li>Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.</li> <li>Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.</li> <li>Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.</li> <li>Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.</li> <li>Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Java or Python.</li> <li>Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.</li> <li>Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>These would be a plus, but We are passionate about Rugby and dedicated to bringing the best experiences to our audience. Our team is growing, and we are looking for talented individuals like you to join us on this exciting journey. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of sports technology across major sporting events. You will be part of a dynamic team delivering world-class tech solutions, designed to make rugby safer, fairer and more engaging. The Rugby department delivers our SMART product across a wide range of high-profile Rugby events all over the globe each year. Want to learn more? Installation and setup of Hawk-Eye technology in the build-up to matches, and performing pre-match checks (this can involve physically demanding work, such as rigging cameras and running cables); Operation of Hawk-Eye video replay technology, supporting users such as Match Officials and Match Day Medical Staff in identifying and reviewing potential incidents Liaise with key stakeholders from broadcasters, companies, match officials and teams to ensure all contractual obligations are seamlessly delivered; Deliver Remote Support to live operations using your technical knowledge and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot hardware and software issues Providing quick resolutions for any technical issues Liaise with our Rugby Remote Support team to ensure smooth setup and match operations Conduct detailed pre-match checks of the system in accordance with standard procedures Monitoring hardware and software performance Taking ownership of our system on-site and representing our company in the best possible manner; Research and development into new projects and technologies; Maintenance of the kit and equipment needed to run the system. Why Is This the Right Job for You? This position is perfect for you if you possess: A technical grounding Strong problem-solving skills Excellent communication with the ability to liaise with clients and customers in a professional and approachable manner Great teamwork skills A passion for innovation A willingness to learn Flexible and willing to travel worldwide on a regular basis The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment An interest in the sport of Rugby Must be currently studying towards an undergraduate degree Team Culture: We pride ourselves on our team culture. Our core values include: Innovation: We constantly seek new ways to improve and innovate in the sports entertainment industry. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - m/f/d
description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Turn AI ambition into production systems that run the business Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. About the Role Most enterprises have bought AI. Far fewer have it running their core operations. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Langdock, you take our most valuable customer use cases from idea to production. You work inside the customer's problem, build the agents, workflows, apps and integrations that solve it, and turn every win into a reusable pattern the whole company can use. You work as part of Customer Success alongside our Account Owner, and you are the technical partner in the customer's transformation. You will feed what you learn in the field back into our product, and you will have real influence over what we build next. And you will build with our own platform every day. Everyone at Langdock automates their own work with agents and workflows. You will too. What You Will Do Run technical discovery on qualified, high-value use cases: map processes, systems, data flows and constraints with both business and technical stakeholders. Design and build production-grade agents, workflows, Skills, Apps and integrations on Langdock, from first prototype to company-wide rollout. Own the implementation of advanced and beta-feature use cases, and of high-profile proofs of concept, together with the Account Owner. Turn individual solutions you built into reusable patterns, templates and on-platform resources, and maintain the bundles repository. Measure impact: time saved, costs reduced, tools replaced, quality improved and time to value. Package the results into ROI stories that customers and colleagues can act on. Support our Partners with architecture reviews, high-profile scoping sessions and targeted enablement, so they can deliver independently. Be the technical voice of the customer internally, without losing sight of our principle: Product > Customer Success > Marketing > Sales. You Might Be a Fit If… You have 3+ years of experience building production software, data or integration systems, ideally in a customer-facing role. You build with AI, not just talk about it. You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agents, tool use, retrieval and workflow automation, and you know how to choose between models and approaches. You can talk credibly about data privacy, security, identity and integration architecture with CISOs, IT leads and engineers, because you have solved these problems before. You are good at scoping. You know which work is worth doing, you say no to the rest, and you ship what you commit to. You translate business problems into technical designs and technical trade-offs into business terms for executives. You are commercially aware. You understand that your work drives retention and expansion, and you care about that outcome. You are fluent in German (C1+) and English. You are a kind person who cares about the people around you. Bonus: you come from an AI-native company or an early-stage startup. Founder or early-employee experience is a plus, as are public projects such as MCP servers, open-source contributions or AI tooling you have shipped. The Environment We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well. The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter. Compensation Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity. We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process. Next steps We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks. If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. Compensation: €90K – €140K • Offers Equity • Base Salary €90K – €140K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI
description: About There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications. Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment. This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users. Focus Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization. Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost. Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking. Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy. Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality. Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data. Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines. Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback. Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX Embeddings, vector search and ranking models Production ML systems and inference pipelines Ideal Experience Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures. Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production. Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization. Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics. Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets. Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability. Strong ownership, problem-solving skills Outcomes ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets. Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality. Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases. Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable. Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results. Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features. How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance
description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the job Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce. You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams. This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week. Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products. You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it. What You'll Do 1. Design & Build AI Systems Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations. Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks. Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails. Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems. 2. Integrate Across the Stack Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company. Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases. Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows. Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack. 3. Iterate for Impact Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI. Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact. Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics. Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration. 4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems. Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready. Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements. Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices. 5. Drive Adoption & Enablement Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers. Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations. Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company. Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce. Our stack and tools Languages: Python and SQL AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes What Makes You Successful Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity Success Metrics Product adoption and business impact Performance and reliability of AI systems Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics You'll Love This Job If you have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments Strong communication skills in English Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on! Want to join us? Here is our process A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return. An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects. 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture. We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
description: Die Rolle Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich! Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln). Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter. Deine Aufgaben: Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt Was Du mitbringst 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift Was die Rolle nicht ist Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets, einen reinen Projektmanager, einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator, einen Presales-Spezialisten, einen reinen Strategen, einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt. Benefits: Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Medizinische Fachangestellte:r (15-30 Stunden in der Woche)
description: Als engagierte:r Medizinische:r Fachangestellte:r bei BEfit, einem führenden Anbieter im Bereich Physiotherapie und Gesundheitssport, sind Sie ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Teams. Sie übernehmen verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in der Patientenbetreuung, Terminorganisation und medizinischen Assistenz und tragen damit maßgeblich zu einem reibungslosen Praxisablauf bei. In einem motivierten Umfeld mit erfahrenen Physiotherapeut:innen, Sporttherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Praxismanager:innen fördern wir gemeinsam die ganzheitliche Gesundheit unserer Patient:innen. Mit Ihrer fachlichen Kompetenz, Ihrem Einfühlungsvermögen und Ihrer strukturierten Arbeitsweise sorgen Sie dafür, dass sich unsere Patient:innen jederzeit bestens aufgehoben fühlen. Wenn Sie eine serviceorientierte und teamfähige Persönlichkeit sind, die Freude an medizinischen Tätigkeiten und Organisation hat, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und helfen Sie uns, jeden Tag den bestmöglichen Service zu bieten. title: Mobile Engineer - React Native
description: <h3 class="p1">🧡<strong> About Alma</strong></h3> <p class="p2">At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h3 class="p1">👐<strong> About the team</strong></h3> <p class="p2">The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.</p> <p class="p2"><strong>Alma Wallet </strong>builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.</p> <p class="p2"><strong>Consumer Engagement </strong>drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.</p> <p class="p2">In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.</p> <p class="p2">This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to <strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gautier-labarre-6b1530146/">Gautier Labarre</a>, Engineering Manager</strong>.</p> <p class="p2"><em>This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.</em></p> <h3 class="p1">💼<strong> About the job</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2"><strong>Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences:</strong> Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Make payments simple and secure:</strong> Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Raise the quality bar of the app:</strong> Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Help the team learn and move forward:</strong> Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">🧰<strong> You will work with</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="p2">Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.</li> <li class="p2">Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, <a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="http://checkout.com/" data-token-index="1"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1174583716">Checkout.com</span></a> SDKs.</li> <li class="p2">Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.</li> <li class="p2">Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">🧩<strong> About you</strong></h3> <p class="p2"><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2">You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with <strong>React Native and TypeScript</strong>, with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.</li> <li class="li2">You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.</li> <li class="li2">You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.</li> <li class="li2">You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><strong>And it will be nice if you also</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2">Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.</li> <li class="li2">Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.</li> <li class="li2">Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.</li> <li class="li2">Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><em>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</em></p> <h3 class="p1">🧘<strong> What's in it for you</strong></h3> <p class="p2">If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:</p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2">Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.</li> <li class="li2">Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.</li> <li class="li2">Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">🤑<strong> Compensation & benefits</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2">Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li class="li2">Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li class="li2">Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li class="li2">Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li class="li2">Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li class="li2">Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li class="li2">Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li class="li2">Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li class="li2">Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li class="li2">Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li class="li2">Access to our Learning & Development Platform</li> <li class="li2">2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">🎯<strong> Interview Process</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li2"><strong>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member</strong> to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Video call with your future manager</strong> to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team</strong> to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join</strong>, with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">🌍<strong> Diversity & Inclusion</strong></p> <p class="p2"><em>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. title: Employee Experience and People Analytics Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);"><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"> roads </span><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. </span></span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)">Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(65, 145, 76);" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)">Job description</span></h2></div><h4>About the team</h4> <p>This is a unique opportunity to shape and lead Castrol’s employee listening and people analytics capability during a critical period of organisational transformation. As the Employee Experience & People Analytics Lead, you will act as the central expert and trusted advisor for employee listening across the business, partnering closely with senior leaders, HR Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, and transformation teams.<br><br>You will have ownership of Castrol’s employee listening platform and strategy, ensuring employee feedback is translated into meaningful action that improves engagement, culture, organisational effectiveness, and business performance. With approximately 6,300 employees across 40 countries, the role offers significant global exposure and the opportunity to influence decision-making at the highest levels.<br><br>This is a highly visible, business-facing role that goes beyond survey administration. Success will come from your ability to combine employee experience expertise, people analytics, stakeholder management, and data storytelling to help leaders make evidence-based decisions during a period of ongoing change.</p> <h4>Key tasks</h4> <ul> <li>Lead Castrol's Employee Listening Capability</li> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for all employee listening and survey activity across the organisation.</li> <li>Own the implementation, configuration, governance, administration, and continuous improvement of the Qualtrics Employee Experience platform.</li> <li>Design and deliver a range of employee listening initiatives, including engagement surveys, pulse surveys, lifecycle surveys, moments that matter surveys, and transformation-related listening programmes.</li> <li>Develop and maintain an employee listening strategy that aligns with Castrol's transformation agenda and business objectives.</li> <li>Establish governance frameworks, survey standards, and reporting methodologies that ensure data privacy, consistency, and insight quality.</li> <li>Deliver actionable workforce insights</li> <li>Analyse employee experience, workforce, talent, and organisational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas for intervention.</li> <li>Combine multiple data sources to provide leadership with a holistic view of organisational health and workforce effectiveness.</li> <li>Support workforce planning, organisational design, talent management, employee engagement, and retention initiatives through data-driven insights.</li> <li>Identify leading indicators and predictive insights that help anticipate workforce risks and opportunities.</li> <li>Influence decision-making through reporting and storytelling</li> <li>Create executive dashboards, leadership scorecards, PowerPoint presentations, and insight packs that translate data into compelling business narratives.</li> <li>Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership teams.</li> <li>Facilitate action-planning discussions and workshops that help leaders convert employee feedback into meaningful organisational outcomes.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor, providing evidence-based recommendations on employee experience and workforce challenges.</li> </ul> <h4>Experience needed</h4> <ul> <li>We're looking for an experienced Employee Experience, People Analytics, or Organisational Effectiveness professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Significant hands-on experience with Qualtrics or similar survey software.</li> <li>Proven experience leading or playing a major role in a full Qualtrics implementation from the ground up.</li> <li>Approximately 5+ years of experience working with employee listening platforms, survey technology, and survey design.</li> <li>Experience building dashboards, managing enterprise reporting frameworks, and generating actionable business insights.</li> <li>Strong people analytics capability, with experience turning workforce and engagement data into compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience operating within large, complex organisations of 1,000+ employees, ideally in global environments.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience supporting employee listening programmes across multiple countries.</li> <li>Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to analyse data and communicate findings effectively.<br><br>What will make you stand out:<br><br></li> <li>Experience supporting global employee populations and large-scale change or transformation programmes.</li> <li>Experience with alternative employee listening platforms such as Medallia, Peakon, Glint, InMoment, or similar technologies.</li> <li>Expertise in employee listening governance, data privacy, survey methodology, and enterprise-scale deployment.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive action from insights.</li> <li>Experience creating executive dashboards, scorecards, and board-level reporting.</li> </ul> <p>We are particularly interested in candidates who have deployed and operated enterprise-scale employee listening programmes rather than those whose experience is limited to academic or survey administration use cases. You should be able to demonstrate how you have used employee feedback, people analytics, and business insight to influence decisions, improve employee experience, and deliver measurable organisational outcomes. Industry background is not important. We are far more interested in your expertise in employee listening, Qualtrics, people analytics, and your ability to partner with leaders to drive meaningful change.<br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span style="color: rgb(65, 145, 76);">Privacy</span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);">The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).</em></span><br><br><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);"><em>If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.</em></span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Educational Videos Actor, UK & Ireland (Freelance)
description: <p>IXL Learning, developer of personalised learning products used by millions of people globally, is looking for camera-loving actors from the UK and Ireland to help us localise our video tutorials. In this role, you will self-tape video footage using provided scripts to teach students different educational concepts in maths or English. <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-REMOTE</span></p> <p><strong>This is a remote consulting role for candidates from the UK or Ireland. </strong></p> <h4>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</h4> <ul> <li>Using pre-written scripts, self-tape short instructional videos for kids and teens; most videos will be a few minutes long and will consist of an on-screen portion and a voiceover portion.</li> <li>Shoot and act in your own videos to deliver clear, engaging, professional lessons</li> <li>Adhere to video production guidelines and file specifications</li> <li>Film reshoots/rerecords when necessary</li> </ul> <h4>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</h4> <ul> <li>Ability to record and produce very high-quality video footage of yourself</li> <li>Engaging on-screen presence for audiences of little kids (ages 5-7), big kids and/or teens</li> <li>Clear, effective presentation style</li> </ul> <p><em>Select candidates will be asked to complete their application by submitting a sample video using a pre-written script. Candidates with the top videos will be selected to move forward with the application process. If hired, you will be compensated with $100 or $150 USD (dependent on video length) upon delivery of each completed video.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4>ABOUT IXL LEARNING</h4> <p>IXL Learning is the country's largest EdTech company. We reach millions of learners through our diverse range of products. For example:</p> <ul> <li>1 in 4 students in the United States uses <a href="https://www.ixl.com/" target="_blank">IXL.com</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.rosettastone.com/" target="_blank">Rosetta Stone</a> provides an immersive learning experience for 25 languages</li> <li><a href="https://www.wyzant.com/" target="_blank">Wyzant</a> is the nation's largest community of tutors, covering 300+ subjects</li> <li><a href="https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/" target="_blank">Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT)</a> is a comprehensive marketplace for millions of educator-created resources</li> </ul> <p>Our mission is to create innovative products that will make a real, positive difference for learners and educators and we're looking for passionate, mission-minded people to join us in achieving this goal. We have a unique culture at IXL that fosters collaboration and the open exchange of ideas. We value our team and treat one another with kindness and respect. We approach our work with passion, tenacity, and authenticity. We find it immensely satisfying to develop products that impact the lives of millions and we are eager to have you join our team.</p> <blockquote> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><em>At IXL, we value diversity in age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, political and religious beliefs, and life experience, and we are proud to promote a work environment where everyone, from any background, can do their best work. IXL Learning is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants and employees based on any legally protected category. </em></span></p> </blockquote></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. As a Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) in Supply division you will make an impact by owning the problem space of supporting operational staff in the field, driving the full product lifecycle from discovery to outcome measurement, working in close partnership with a global landscape of stakeholders, and shaping the next generation of our products. At the centre of this problem space is an app supporting bus drivers, train attendants and station staff in their daily operations around the world. This Android application does not only provide key workflows to its users, but also allows Flix to better understand operational compliance in the field so we can guarantee the best possible passenger experience. We're currently building the next generation of this app, making this an exciting moment to join and shape its long-term direction. Your engineering counterparts are an Engineering Manager, three Backend engineers, two Mobile engineers and one Data Analyst. Your focus will be on strategy, discovery, and outcomes, while the engineering team owns delivery and ceremonies. If you're excited about working on a constantly evolving product used by thousands of operational staff around the world, send us your application! About the Role Own the product lifecycle end-to-end: from identifying opportunities and running discovery , through shaping solutions and defining requirements , to measuring outcomes and closing the loop Co- own your problem space with business counterparts , building a joint partnership that replaces handover-based collaboration with shared accountability for outcomes Define product strategy and priorities for the app , working across teams and problem spaces rather than being bounded by a single team's scope Drive hypothesis-driven discovery and outcome measurement , defining success metrics before solution work begins and using them to make explicit continue , pivot , or stop decisions Partner closely with engineering on priorities , requirements , and release , trusting the EM and team to own delivery and ceremonies Collaborate with peer Product Owners to align on dependencies and deliver outcomes that span individual team boundaries About You 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a track record of owning products end-to-end: from problem discovery and business alignment to outcome measurement You think in outcomes and problem spaces; presenting a business case to a stakeholder feels as natural as running a discovery session with users Proven ability to build strong working relationships with business stakeholders and drive joint decision-making without relying on formal authority Experience owning product problems that cut across team boundaries, keeping multiple stakeholders aligned on direction and trade-offs You're energised by strategy, discovery, and outcomes; you understand that delivery coordination sits with the engineering team Strong analytical foundation; you can connect user research, usability signals, and business metrics to make confident product decisions Nice-to-have: Experience with mobile app products, ideally in an operational or logistics context We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. title: Senior AI R&D Engineer - Performance - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring a Senior Performance Engineer to grow our pre-training efficiency team. If you are excited about making models fast and scaling them to thousands of GPUs, this is the role for you! Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. About the role: You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel. This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH. Your responsibilities: End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput. Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training. Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle). Deeply understand the CUDA programming model. Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI. Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight. Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team. Preferred Qualifications Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed). Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput. A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance. A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training. A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.</p> <h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p>This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.</p> <p>This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.</p> <p>The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.</p> <h1><strong>What You’ll Do: The Recipe</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Lead from the front. </strong>Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.</li> <li><strong>Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. </strong>From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.</li> <li><strong>Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. </strong>Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.</li> <li><strong>Make us AI-native. </strong>Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.</li> <li><strong>Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. </strong>Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. title: Director of Retention & Monetisation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p><strong>Impact</strong><strong><br></strong>Most of our UK investment to date has gone into winning patients. This role owns what happens next — whether they stay, whether they grow, and whether the revenue they generate is actually profitable. You will own <strong>Repeat Contribution Margin</strong> for the UK: repeat revenue minus the variable cost to serve it, across Hims and Hers in weight-loss, hair, sexual health and TRT. It is a single number and it is yours. You'll report to the Managing Director, UK and sit alongside the two brand Directors of Growth, who own new patient acquisition.</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own UK Repeat Contribution Margin</strong> — both halves: repeat revenue <em>and</em> the variable cost to serve, including retention-linked COGS. Commercial sets the P&L target and owns the model and guardrails; you choose the levers within it, build the plan, and land the number.</li> <li><strong>Run the monetisation portfolio</strong> — expansion levers (cross-sell across conditions, service packages and premium tiers, Shop and physical add-ons, paid diagnostics for existing patients) and margin-protection levers (upsell to commit-and-save plans, titration and maintenance plans, cancellation saves, reactivation, loyalty). Decide where to invest, size the prize, and kill what isn't working.</li> <li><strong>Own churn and save economics</strong> — cancellation saves, reactivation and win-back. Churn modelling and automated save offers are already in flight; your job is to turn that into a governed P&L lever and to prove incrementality rather than bank credit for patients who'd have returned anyway.</li> <li><strong>Own the whole post-purchase journey</strong> — from activation through to lifetime. Where Proposition defines and builds a new offer for a core category, operational execution post-purchase hands off to you.</li> <li><strong>Lead a condition-level retention team of four</strong> — a Head of Retention for weight-loss across both brands (with a Strategy & Ops Lead beneath them), plus S&O Leads for Hair/Sex and for TRT, the latter including activation ops from blood test to first order. Build the bench and raise the bar.</li> <li><strong>Direct the central and shared functions without managing them</strong> — you decide and brief; CRM, Patient Support, Clinical Ops, Clinical Outcomes and Product build. You set the experience standard, approve the SLA and cost line, and hold each function to its impact. You will not set clinical protocol, and you will need to be effective without line authority.</li> <li><strong>Surface, prioritise and win the product roadmap</strong> — turn retention friction into a prioritised requirement list with a business case, and pitch it to the MD against acquisition work that is easier to justify.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What good looks like.</strong> A first six months that delivers a Repeat Contribution Margin baseline everyone trusts, condition-level cost attribution phased in behind it, two or three monetisation levers live with clean reads, and a save programme that survives an incrementality test.</p> <p> </p> <h2>About you</h2> <h3>Skills & experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>You have 10-12 years of experience across D2C brands </strong>running P&Ls and owning commercial targets. </li> <li><strong>You've owned a repeat-revenue or contribution-margin number in a subscription or repeat-purchase consumer business</strong> — not influenced it, owned it. You can talk through the plan you set, what you got wrong, and what you'd do differently.</li> <li><strong>You've built a monetisation portfolio, not just run retention campaigns.</strong> Pricing and packaging, upsell and cross-sell, plan structures, loyalty — you've decided what to build, sized it, and killed the ones that didn't earn their place.</li> <li><strong>You are commercially and analytically rigorous on the cost side.</strong> You understand contribution margin properly, you've worked with imperfect cost attribution and made decisions anyway, and you hold a hard line on incrementality — including when a flattering headline number is on offer.</li> <li><strong>You've delivered through functions you don't manage.</strong> CRM, support, ops, clinical, product. You know how to set a standard, agree an SLA, and hold people to impact using influence and evidence rather than reporting lines.</li> <li><strong>You've led and built a small senior team</strong> — hired well, levelled honestly, and given people real ownership of sub-numbers.</li> <li><strong>You operate at pace in ambiguity and bring your own point of view.</strong> This role has no playbook at Euc. You'll be expected to anchor the direction rather than wait for the MD or Commercial to set the agenda.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to haves</h3> <ul> <li>Healthcare, or another regulated, trust-based consumer category where what you can say and offer is genuinely constrained.</li> <li>Experience across more than one market — Germany mirrors this model as it matures, and weight-loss retention may become EMEA-wide.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Creative Design (m/w/d)
description: Wer sind wir? Wir sind eine stark wachsende Google Ads Agentur mit Sitz in München. Unser dynamisches Team aus Digital Natives betreut die spannendsten E-Commerce Brands und macht sie zu den Marktführern im DACH-Markt. Um unser ambitioniertes Wachstumsziel im Bereich SEA zu erreichen, suchen wir dich als kreativen Kopf für unser Team. Deine Mission: Du entwirfst herausragende Creatives, die nicht nur ins Auge fallen, sondern auch unsere Kunden im E-Commerce auf Google Ads glänzen lassen. Als zentraler Teil unseres Creative-Teams unterstützt du unsere kreative Leitung und sorgst dafür, dass sowohl Kundenprojekte als auch interne To-dos schnell und in Top-Qualität umgesetzt werden. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für visuelles Storytelling hast und lernen willst, wie man Designs entwickelt, die wirklich konvertieren, dann bist du hier genau richtig! Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Als Werkstudent im Grafikdesign bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unseren visuellen Werbemitteln und trägst maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Kundenkampagnen bei. Deine täglichen Aufgaben umfassen: Creative-Erstellung für Google Ads: Du konzipierst und gestaltest wirkungsvolle Werbemittel (statische Grafiken & Videos), die auf Google Ads für hohe Klickraten und Conversions sorgen. Markenkonsistenz: Du erstellst CI-konforme Online-Werbemittel und sorgst für einen einheitlichen und professionellen Auftritt unserer Kunden über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg. KI-gestütztes Design: Du nutzt innovative KI-Tools, um den Designprozess zu beschleunigen, neue kreative Möglichkeiten zu erschließen und die Bildbearbeitung zu optimieren. Strategischer Input: Du entwickelst ein Verständnis für die wichtigsten KPIs, bringst proaktiv kreative Ideen für Kampagnen ein und hilfst dabei, Design-Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten zu treffen. Interne Grafik-Power: Du unterstützt das Team schnell und zuverlässig bei internen Design-Aufgaben, von Präsentationen über Social-Media-Grafiken bis hin zu Bannern. Deine Chance: Du arbeitest direkt mit Heike, unserer kreativen Leitung, zusammen, lernst von den Besten und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Welt des Performance-Marketings. Hier kannst du dein theoretisches Wissen praktisch anwenden, über dich hinauswachsen und den Grundstein für deine Karriere im digitalen Marketing legen. Qualifikation Kreativität & Leidenschaft: Deine Passion für Design ist ansteckend. Du denkst "out of the box", bringst frische Ideen mit und hast ein Growth Mindset – du siehst Probleme als Chancen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Design-Skills: Du beherrschst Photoshop oder Figma im Schlaf und hast gute Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Cloud (z.B. Illustrator). Erfahrung mit Videobearbeitungstools wie CapCut ist ein großes Plus. Erfahrung: Du hast idealerweise 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Grafikbereich, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, eine Ausbildung als Mediengestalter oder erste Jobs in Voll- oder Teilzeit. Zielgruppen-Empathie: Du kannst dich mühelos in die Zielgruppen und deren "Pain Points" in verschiedensten Branchen hineinversetzen und leitest daraus treffsichere Designs ab. Neugier & Trendgespür: Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den Einsatz von KI im Kreativbereich und ein starkes Interesse an aktuellen Design- und Marketingtrends. Persönlichkeit: Du bist ein organisierter und ergebnisorientierter Teamplayer, der sich weiterentwickeln möchte und strukturiert an Aufgaben herangeht . Benefits Die Chance, unser außergewöhnliches Wachstum signifikant mitzugestalten Agenturgründer, die eine klare Vision für die Agentur haben und das Wachstum aller Mitarbeitenden proaktiv fördern Ein ambitioniertes Team, in dessen positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre du dich wohlfühlen wirst. Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe im Team und kurze Entscheidungswege – hier machen deine Ideen und deine Arbeit den Unterschied. Du bist kein kleines Zahnrad im System, sondern kannst Prozesse prägend mitgestalten! Legendäre Team Events und Workations, die dir in Erinnerung bleiben werden. Benefits wie neuestes Apple Equipment, Wellpass und das Bezahlen von Kursen & Co. sind für uns selbstverständlich - bei allem anderen: Lass uns einfach darüber reden! title: Machine Learning Certification Researcher
description: About the Role Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test. At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most. What You'll Do • AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML. • EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines. • Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions. • Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics. • Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI. • Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks. • Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks. Requirements What You'll Need Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics • ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks. • Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes. • Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding). Research Rigor • Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline). • Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations. Education • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Theoretical Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative research field. Who You Are • Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything. You naturally challenge conventional ML assumptions, probe for hidden edge cases, and refuse to take empirical accuracy at face value without rigorous proof. • Logical Argument Building: You have an exceptional ability to construct robust, airtight logical arguments and technical justifications. You can translate complex empirical observations into structured, defensible evidence that satisfies strict engineering and regulatory scrutiny. • Thrives in Ambiguity: You are motivated by hard, unsolved mathematical problems at the intersection of theoretical computer science, safety engineering, and real-world flight operations Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
