title: Senior Software Engineer, R2 Metadata
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | <strong>Austin, TX | London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Metadata team owns the metadata layer that underpins every R2 operation, every object put, get, list, and delete flows through the systems we build and operate.</p> <p>R2 is growing rapidly, and the metadata layer must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.</li> <li>Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Senior Customer Engineer, Named - Vancouver, BC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Vancouver, BC</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role will require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other in-person team meetings, within the assigned territory. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). title: Projektleiter HKLS / Versorgungstechnik (m/w/d)
description: Sie möchten technisch anspruchsvolle Großprojekte in der Gebäudeausrüstung leiten, abends aber verlässlich zu Hause bei Ihrer Familie sein? Hier übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für Vorhaben bis 10 Millionen Euro Volumen und profitieren dabei von echtem Zusammenhalt und einem Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung. Sie suchen nach einer Position mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, wünschen sich aber dennoch die finanzielle Sicherheit eines Großkonzerns mit vollen Auftragsbüchern bis 2029? Sie schätzen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Leistung anerkannt wird und Kollegen einander auf der Baustelle wirklich unterstützen. Dann erwartet Sie hier bei einem Gehalt von 65.000 bis 85.000 € je nach Erfahrung genau diese Kombination. Ihr neuer Arbeitgeber ist eine mittelständisch geprägte Geschäftseinheit innerhalb eines großen europäischen Konzerns. Das Unternehmen agiert als Gesamtdienstleister für die technische Gebäudeausrüstung und realisiert regionale Großprojekte in den Bereichen Industrie, Gesundheitswesen und öffentliche Hand. Die Niederlassung verbindet den pragmatischen Zusammenhalt eines Handwerksbetriebs mit der Struktur und Finanzkraft eines großen Netzwerks. Projektleiter HKLS / Versorgungstechnik (m/w/d) | 65.000-85.000 € brutto/Jahr + Firmenwagen Ihre Perspektiven Regionale Projekte & Freizeit: Sie steuern Projekte im Umkreis von 100 bis 150 Kilometern und übernachten im eigenen Bett. Eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance wird durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit und eine flexible Einteilung unterstützt. Stabilität & Freiraum: Die Auftragsbücher sind bis 2029 gefüllt. Gleichzeitig agieren Sie in Ihrem Projekt wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen und haben die Freiheit, Abläufe im Sinne des Projekterfolgs pragmatisch anzupassen. Fahrzeug & Ausstattung: Sie erhalten einen frei konfigurierbaren Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung der Marken VW, BMW, Ford oder Mercedes. Moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Laptop und Smartphone sind selbstverständlich. Echte Wertschätzung: Hier sind Sie keine Personalnummer. Flache Hierarchien, ein familiärer Teamzusammenhalt und Vorgesetzte, die bei Problemen den Rücken stärken und selbst mit auf die Baustelle kommen, prägen den Alltag. Zusatzleistungen & Gesundheit: Sie profitieren von Angeboten wie EGYM Wellpass, Jobrad, Corporate Benefits und einer betrieblichen Zusatzkrankenversicherung. Gemeinsame Sommerfeste, Kickerturniere und Ausflüge runden das Angebot ab. Ihre Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche Projektleitung im Bereich Heizung, Klima, Lüftung und Sanitär für Vorhaben zwischen 500.000 und 10 Millionen Euro Volumen. Sie steuern den gesamten Projektablauf von der Werk- und Montageplanung ab der Leistungsphase 5 bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Kunden. Sie koordinieren und überwachen Nachunternehmer sowie Lieferanten, da das Unternehmen die Anlagenplanung und -steuerung ohne eigene Montagekapazitäten durchführt. Sie behalten Zeit, Budget und Qualität stets im Blick und stellen den Projekterfolg durch eine vorausschauende Kapazitäts- und Personaleinsatzplanung sicher. Sie prüfen Planungsunterlagen kritisch, bewerten die eingesetzte Technik vor allem auf der Luft- und Wasserseite und decken Planungsfehler frühzeitig auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bauleitern vor Ort zusammen und greifen bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert ein. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung im Bereich HKLS (z. B. Anlagenmechaniker SHK, Heizungsbauer) Oder alternativ Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker / Meister in der Versorgungstechnik Oder alternativ ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung, Versorgungstechnik oder Umwelttechnik Fundierte Berufserfahrung ab 7 Jahren in der eigenverantwortlichen Bau- und Projektleitung von HKLS-Anlagenbauprojekten mit Volumina im Millionenbereich innerhalb Deutschlands. Sicheres technisches Fachwissen in der Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik (inkl. Brandschutz) sowie auf der Wasserseite (Hydraulik, Pumpenauslegung). Sicherer Umgang mit der VOB (A, B, C) sowie den einschlägigen DIN-Normen. Routinierter Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen oder PlanRadar sind von Vorteil. Deutsch: C1 Führerschein der Klasse B. Lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Resilienz bei Projektdruck und die Fähigkeit, konstruktiv mit Nachunternehmern sowie Kunden zu kommunizieren. Interessiert? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt unkompliziert bei Ihrer Ansprechpartnerin Juliane Stork. Ihre Beratung durch Riverstate ist für Sie selbstverständlich kostenlos. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank gehalten: In der Regel findet nur ein einziges Gespräch direkt mit der Fachabteilung und der Geschäftsführung statt. title: Deputy Accounting Director (freelance/contractor)
description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information, visit www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the role Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment. Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close. The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management. Contractor 6 months Start: ASAP Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois) Key responsibilities Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment. Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl's entities. Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances. Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues. Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures. Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties. Accounting operations and close support Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process. Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries. Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions. Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl's international perimeter. Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders. Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date. Finance transformation, automation and AI Contribute to Mirakl's Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations. Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support. Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders. Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives. Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working. Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes. Candidate profile 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage. Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls. Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries. Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases. Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills. Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage. We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. title: Senior Account Executive, Startups (Southeast)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Charlotte OR Raleigh, NC</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p>Senior AEs at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in North America. In targeting high-growth, technologically advanced, and venture-backed companies, AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within teh Territory focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Mid Market accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS</li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative</li> <li>Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on level and work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000 - $321,000</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin TX, San Francisco CA, NYC, Atlanta GA OR Denver CO</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The GTM Intelligence team helps Cloudflare's go-to-market organization make faster, better decisions with trusted data. We work with Sales, Technical Sales, Services, Finance, and our central Data teams to make sure the people who sell, deploy, and support Cloudflare get consistent, reliable answers to the questions that matter most.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior GTM Analytics Manager to set and execute the vision for how information scales across Cloudflare's technical customer-facing teams. You'll support Pre- and Post-Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Professional Services.</p> <p>This role is less about building more dashboards or doing one-off deep dives and more about building the foundations to support true self-serve analytics.  You will focus on single source of truth artifacts, strategic alignment of metrics to actions, and the data models, metric definitions, and context layers that let anyone in these organizations get a trustworthy answer that fits their needs. That person might be an executive, a frontline manager, an engineer in the field, or an AI agent working for any of them.</p> <p>You'll be a technical expert and a strategic partner in one. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a dimensional model with Data Engineering as you are agreeing a metric definition with a VP of Professional Services. And you'll be our go-to voice on how analytics should change now that more and more questions get answered through AI.</p> <h4><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role with wide influence and no direct reports.</strong></h4> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Define and drive a multi-year strategy for how Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, and Professional Services find, trust, and use data, including a maturity model and a phased roadmap.</li> <li>Act as a thought leader on scaling information in an AI-first world, working out how semantic layers, governed metrics, and well-built context let AI assistants and agents give accurate, consistent answers grounded in our business.</li> <li>Review the current mix of dashboards, reports, and tools across these teams. Create a plan to consolidate them, retire duplicates, and move toward a single source of truth.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Define, document, and carry out the official metrics for the teams you support. </li> <li>Keep metric definitions aligned with corporate definitions from Finance and Data, and resolve conflicts between teams with clear, defensible logic.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Act as the main business and technical partner to the central Data team for the stakeholders you support. </li> <li>Influence and review the design of data models across systems such as Salesforce, professional services tools, product usage and telemetry, support, and finance.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Design how people get answers: self-serve access, natural-language and AI-assisted querying, embedded insights in daily workflows, and curated metric catalogs.</li> <li>Set up a formal intake and governance process for new metric and data requests, including prioritization, ownership, certification, and change management.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with leaders in Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, Professional Services, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, and Data.</li> <li>Explain complex technical and analytical ideas clearly to executives so they can make decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>8+ years in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or GTM/Services operations at a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.</li> <li>Direct experience supporting at least one of the following: Pre- or Post-Sales Operations, Solutions/Sales Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Professional Services, or Customer Success. You understand how these teams work, how they're measured, and how their data is created.</li> <li>Deep data modeling expertise, including dimensional modeling, entity design, and metric layer design. You can review and challenge a data model, not just consume one.</li> <li>Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stack tools such as BigQuery, dbt, or a semantic/metrics layer (for example dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or Cube).</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of GTM and services systems data, such as Salesforce, professional services automation tools, and product usage or telemetry data.</li> <li>A clear, informed view on how AI changes analytics, including semantic layers, retrieval and context design for LLMs, text-to-SQL, and agent-based access to governed data, plus the data foundations those need to be accurate.</li> <li>A track record of defining and rolling out source-of-truth metrics across multiple stakeholder groups, including handling disagreements over definitions.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs without formal authority, and to influence executives and engineers alike.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including turning ambiguous business questions into precise technical requirements and back again.</li> <li>BA/BS in a quantitative, technical, or business field. A Master's in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, or an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $167,000 - title: Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – IT-Lösungen für Healthcare & Public Sector
description: Neue Kunden gewinnen ist Ihr Geschäft. Zukunftsmärkte gestalten Ihre Chance. Healthcare und Public Sector stehen vor komplexen Digitalisierungsaufgaben. Dafür reicht es nicht, einzelne Softwareprodukte anzubieten: Gefragt sind Beratung, moderne Technologien und Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag funktionieren. Genau hier setzen Sie mit Ihrer Vertriebserfahrung an. Für einen etablierten IT-Dienstleister suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Gesundheitswesen und öffentlichen Sektor erschließt. Unser Mandant begleitet seine Kunden über den gesamten Lebenszyklus anspruchsvoller IT-Vorhaben: von Business- und IT-Beratung, Prozessanalyse und Transformation über Cloud, Infrastruktur, DevOps, Cybersecurity und Daten- und KI-Lösungen bis zu SAP, individueller Softwareentwicklung, Integration und IT-Betrieb. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln strategische Partnerschaften und machen gemeinsam mit Consulting- und Delivery-Teams aus komplexen Anforderungen konkrete Digitalisierungsprojekte. Ihre Aufgaben – Vertrieb mit Gestaltungsspielraum Geschäftsentwicklung: Sie identifizieren neue Marktpotenziale, gewinnen Kunden im Gesundheitswesen und öffentlichen Sektor und etablieren langfristige Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf Fachbereichs- und Managementebene. Ganzheitliche Vertriebsverantwortung: Sie steuern den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der Identifikation und Qualifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten über Akquise und Angebotserstellung bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Lösungsorientierte Beratung: Sie analysieren die Digitalisierungsanforderungen potenzieller Kunden und entwickeln gemeinsam mit internen Experten passende Angebote aus dem breiten Beratungs- und Technologieportfolio – einschließlich IT-Consulting und Softwarelösungen. Projektentwicklung und Umsetzung: Sie arbeiten eng mit Consulting- und Delivery-Teams zusammen, um Kundenprojekte erfolgreich zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Netzwerk und Marktpräsenz: Sie bauen Kontakte in Ihren Zielbranchen aus, repräsentieren das Unternehmen gegenüber Kunden sowie auf Fach- und Branchenveranstaltungen und identifizieren neue Geschäftschancen. Strategische Mitgestaltung: Sie bringen Ihre Marktkenntnisse und Vertriebserfahrungen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebsstrategie ein. Sie berichten direkt an die Geschäftsleitung. Ihr Profil – Vertriebserfahrung trifft Branchenverständnis Erfahrung im IT-Vertrieb: Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Direktvertrieb von IT-Dienstleistungen, Consulting oder vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Lösungen. Branchenkenntnisse: Sie kennen die Anforderungen des Gesundheitswesens und/oder des öffentlichen Sektors. Ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern ist von Vorteil. Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge: Sie haben erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und langfristige, tragfähige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut. Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke: Sie überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und können komplexe Themen auf Managementebene verständlich präsentieren und erfolgreich verhandeln. Unternehmerisches Denken: Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, handeln ergebnisorientiert und bringen Eigeninitiative sowie ausgeprägte Abschlussstärke mit. Technologieverständnis: Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und können den geschäftlichen Mehrwert anspruchsvoller IT-Lösungen überzeugend vermitteln. Was Sie erwartet Innovation und KI: Ein technologieorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich künstlicher Intelligenz aufgreifen und Innovationen in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten können. Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklung: Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Entwicklungs- und Qualifizierungsangebote. Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Gleitzeit, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und weitere familienfreundliche Arbeitsmodelle. Urlaub und soziales Engagement: 30 Urlaubstage sowie ein zusätzlicher freier Tag rund um Weihnachten oder Silvester und ein weiterer Tag für ehrenamtliches Engagement. Zusätzliche Leistungen: Monatliche Guthabenleistungen, die für Gutscheine oder als Mobilitätszuschuss genutzt werden können, sowie die Möglichkeit zum Dienstrad-Leasing. Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld: Kostenlose Getränke und regelmäßige gemeinsame Teamveranstaltungen. Interesse geweckt? Aus Ihrer nächsten Kundenbeziehung könnte ein wegweisendes Digitalisierungsprojekt entstehen. Sie möchten nicht nur Vertriebsziele erreichen, sondern neue Märkte mitgestalten? In dieser Position bringen Sie anspruchsvolle Kundenanforderungen mit erfahrenen IT-Experten zusammen, entwickeln nachhaltige Partnerschaften und sehen, wie aus Ihren Ideen konkrete Projekte werden. Wenn Sie Verantwortung übernehmen und Healthcare sowie Public Sector aktiv voranbringen möchten, sollten wir miteinander sprechen. Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über unser Bewerbungsportal oder Ihre direkte Kontaktaufnahme mit eAces. Selbstverständlich behandeln wir Ihre Bewerbung vertraulich. Weitere Informationen zur Position und zum Unternehmen erhalten Sie im persönlichen Austausch. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

<li><strong>External engagement:</strong> Build and sustain peer-to-peer relationships with key experts, multidisciplinary care teams, scientific societies, rare-disease networks, and patient organizations while preserving the independence and integrity of scientific exchange</li> <li><strong>Expert and center mapping:</strong> Identify and segment relevant centers and stakeholders, characterize referral and treatment pathways, and help quantify patient populations and unmet medical needs across France</li> <li><strong>Medical insights:</strong> Capture, document, analyze, and communicate actionable field insights to the local and global organization, and close the loop by showing how validated insights inform strategy and execution</li> <li><strong>Scientific exchange and education:</strong> Deliver balanced, non-promotional scientific exchange; lead advisory boards, expert meetings, congress activities, internal training, and other medical education initiatives</li> <li><strong>Evidence generation:</strong> Contribute to the local evidence plan, including real-world evidence, registries, epidemiology, outcomes research, collaborative studies, and investigator-sponsored research; support protocol and publication review as appropriate</li> <li><strong>Launch and access readiness:</strong> Support pre-launch and launch activities by clarifying unmet need, patient identification and referral pathways, multidisciplinary care requirements, and evidence gaps; contribute medical input to early or compassionate access activities when applicable</li> <li><strong>Medical review:</strong> Provide robust medical review of scientific, educational, market access, and promotional materials through the appropriate review process, ensuring scientific accuracy, fair balance, and consistency with approved information and company standards</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Patient Advocacy, Pharmacovigilance, Compliance, and global or regional Medical Affairs while maintaining the appropriate separation between medical and promotional activities</li> <li><strong>Safety and quality:</strong> Identify and report adverse events, product complaints, and other safety information within required timelines; maintain complete documentation and complete all required training</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You'll Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This is a France-based role with the Paris area as the designated office location.</li> <li>Regular travel across France is expected, with periodic travel to the International Headquarters in Zug, Switzerland, and to other countries in the Europe West region (Belgium, Netherlands, Eastern Europe)</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>MD, PharmD, PhD, or another advanced scientific or healthcare degree</li> <li>At least 3-5 years of Medical Affairs experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including meaningful experience in France</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage healthcare professionals in high-quality scientific exchange and to convert If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>You will report to the Director, Medical Excellence & Operations, International, and work closely with International Medical Affairs, Field Medical, Clinical Development, Commercial, Legal and Regulatory colleagues to strengthen medical excellence across BridgeBio. Your primary purpose will be to lead medical excellence initiatives across the Medical Affairs organization, such as scientific communications, field medical, training and other medical excellence priorities as the business evolves. This role requires effective collaboration with Medical Directors, cross-functional colleagues and external experts to ensure scientifically rigorous, consistent and compliant communications and practices. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in scientific/medical communications with strong project management experience and stakeholder management skills, and thrives on delivering priorities in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Support the development of scientific communication plans from an international perspective (i.e., core scientific narratives, key messages and Q&A documents), in close collaboration with Medical Directors and cross-functional brand teams</li> <li>Develop high-quality scientific and medical education content for congresses, symposia, advisory boards, internal training and other settings, ensuring alignment with the medical strategy</li> <li>Partner with Legal, Regulatory and Medical reviewers to ensure all scientific and medical communications are accurate, balanced and compliant, in line with the Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review process</li> <li>Support the design and delivery of onboarding, training and continuous learning programs for Medical Affairs, including building scientific and therapeutic area capability across the organization</li> <li>Manage relationships with medical communications agencies, medical writers and other vendors to ensure high-quality, on-time, on-budget deliverables</li> <li>Support the review, evaluation and compliant administration of independent medical education grants, scientific sponsorships and related third-party contracting, partnering with Legal, Compliance and Finance to ensure appropriate governance and documentation</li> <li>Contribute to the development of standards, processes, tools and best practices that elevate medical excellence across areas such as Field Medical, insights generation & analysis, key performance indicators, training and other Medical Affairs priorities as business needs evolve</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work  </u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This is an office role and requires in-office collaboration 2-3 days per week in our Zug office</li> <li>No relocation is offered</li> <li>Travel (approximately 10-20%) may be required to support scientific congresses, advisory boards, training sessions and internal meetings</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or a related scientific discipline is required; an advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or MSc) is strongly preferred</li> <li>7+ years of Medical Affairs experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, in one or more of the following areas: scientific/medical communications, field medical, medical training, or related medical excellence functions</li> <li>Strong scientific writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate materials</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing scientific platforms, key messages, and training or capability-building programs in partnership with cross-functional medical and clinical teams</li> <li>Experience managing external vendors/agencies and navigating MLR review processes; familiarity with grants, sponsorships, or contracting processes is an advantage</li> <li>Versatile and adaptable, able to shift between medical excellence priorities as business needs evolve</li> <li>Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills; experience in rare disease is an advantage</li> <li>Fluent in English; additional language skills are an advantage</li> </ul> <p> </p> This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: BridgeBio's operating model delivers International IT work through external vendors and consultants, and this role provides both the strategic direction and the hands-on technical expertise needed to design, direct, and validate that work. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.</p> <p>You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to opportunity to join a high-impact, dynamic team as an individual contributor, shaping the IT roadmap and business strategy that help accelerate life-changing treatments for patients.</p> If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Manager, Commercial Sourcing and Contracts will report directly to the Head of International Supply Chain. This role will be responsible for supporting the development and execution of sourcing strategies, managing the end-to-end contracting lifecycle for commercial goods and services. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, CMC and Quality) to manage supplier relationships and ensure contractual compliance across Contract Manufacturing Organizations.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities:</u></strong></h3> <p><strong>Sourcing Strategy & Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development and implementation of sourcing strategies for Contract Manufacturing Organizations</li> <li>Support RFP processes, supplier evaluations, and negotiations to secure optimal cost, quality, and service outcomes</li> <li>Conduct market analysis and benchmarking to support the identification of sourcing opportunities and mitigate supply risk</li> <li>Drive supplier consolidation, dual-sourcing, or diversification strategies where appropriate</li> </ul> <p><strong>Contract Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft, negotiate, and finalize commercial contracts, master service agreements (MSAs), and supply agreements in collaboration with the relevant stakeholders</li> <li>Maintain a contract repository/tracker ensuring visibility of key terms, renewal dates, and obligations</li> <li>Manage contract amendments, renewals, and terminations in line with business needs and risk exposure</li> </ul> <p><strong>Supplier Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as primary Commercial Supply Chain point of contact for Contract Manufacturing Organizations, managing performance reviews and escalations</li> <li>Monitor supplier performance against SLAs/KPIs and drive corrective action plans where needed with relevant stakeholders</li> <li>Support supplier risk assessments (financial, operational, compliance) in coordination with Quality and Supply Chain</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work</u></strong><u>  </u></h3> <p>This is a hybrid role based in the Netherlands, with approximately 10–15% travel anticipated to visit Contract Manufacturing Organizations.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field, such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or Business Administration</li> <li>Minimum of 10 years of supply chain experience</li> <li>Life sciences industry experience; experience with commercial products is a plus</li> <li>Demonstrated experience negotiating and managing commercial contracts with Contract Manufacturing Organizations in a regulated environment</li> <li>Strong negotiation skills</li> <li>Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships, both internally and externally</li> title: Senior Sales Engineer - Data & AI Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the Role: </strong> </p> <p>Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to drive technical leadership in our sales team, focusing on the Securiti AI portfolio. You will partner with a Securiti Sales Specialist and support 3–5 Account Executives and Veeam Solution Engineers as the technical subject matter expert. </p> <p>You will guide customers from needs assessment to solution design, delivering hands-on demos and proof-of-concepts to showcase value. Success in this role requires strong technical skills and the ability to build trust with clients. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary technical contact for Securiti AI solutions during the sales cycle</li> <li>Lead technical discussions and deliver customized security solutions</li> <li>Address customer needs in data discovery, posture management, and compliance</li> <li>Design and present product demonstrations and proof-of-concepts</li> <li>Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure smooth transitions </li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in pre-sales or sales engineering</li> <li>Strong understanding of data and/or cloud security</li> <li>Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders</li> <li>10+ years technical sales experience in security</li> <li>15+ years in Software/SaaS/Enterprise technical sales</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP</li> <li>Knowledge of data privacy/security standards (e.g., GDPR, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001)</li> <li>Experience with DSPM frameworks, Linux, Kubernetes, or cloud data systems</li> <li>Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, or cloud-specific) </li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Get: </strong></p> <p>Veeam offers benefits that support your whole self: </p> <ul> <li>30 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares</li> <li>Statutory public health insurance with employer and employee contributions</li> <li>Statutory pension scheme with employer and employee contributions</li> <li>Statutory accident insurance fully funded by Veeam</li> <li>Supplemental pension plan with employer match and salary sacrifice option</li> <li>Supplemental accident insurance with 24/7 worldwide coverage</li> <li>Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning</li> </ul> <p>Please note: If an applicant is permanently located outside of Germany, Veeam reserves the right to decline the application for this position.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"><span data-teams="true"><span class="TextRun SCXW120683981 BCX0" title: Staff Software Engineer, Containers
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. <br><br>Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. <br><br>Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.</p></div><h3><strong>Who we are</strong></h3> <p>Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.</p> <p>Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.</p> <p>Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.</p> <h3><strong>The role, in a nutshell</strong></h3> <p>Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Staff Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, and you will lead the small sub-teams of two to four engineers that own them.</p> <p>Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.</p> <p>This is a product role with technical ownership. You will set direction for major new capabilities, make the architectural calls that affect the team and the teams next to it, and multiply the output of the engineers around you. You will stay hands-on: most of your week is still building.</p> <h3><strong>What the team owns</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Product features for Chainguard Containers.</strong> Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).</li> <li><strong>The image build pipeline.</strong> The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Registry performance and distribution.</strong> Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.</li> <li><strong>Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents.</strong> Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect and drive the delivery of major new features and services for Chainguard Containers, often spanning several engineers or teams, from concept through production and the first weeks of customer use.</li> <li>Make and own the high-leverage trade-offs: which capability to build first, what to defer, when to re-platform and when not to. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.</li> <li>Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and set the standard for how the team uses them safely as volume grows.</li> <li>Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, and work across team boundaries to get ahead of planning cycles.</li> <li>Mentor and level up other engineers through design review and pair work, and set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and ships.</li> <li>Partner with Product and engineering leadership on roadmap, bringing a technical point of view to what we build, not only how.</li> <li>Keep the systems you own healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.</li> <li>Write clearly and often. Design notes, decision records, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, including leading at least one multi-engineer project end to end, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.</li> <li>High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you unblock others.</li> <li>Judgment on trade-offs at the system level. You have made calls that moved a roadmap, and you can show what you gave up and why.</li> <li>A systems thinker who designs for the whole path: build pipeline, registry, distribution, and the customer's runtime, and who sees second-order effects before they land.</li> <li>AI-native in how you build and lead. You use agentic coding tools daily and you have changed how a team works because of them.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity. You can turn a half-defined product goal into a concrete technical plan, and pivot when priorities shift.</li> <li>Architectural depth in Go: you can design a Go service from scratch, not only contribute to one, plus strong API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of containers, container registries, the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), and Kubernetes.</li> <li>A track record of mentoring engineers and raising technical practices across a team.</li> <li>Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad.</li> <li>Excellent written English and experience working on a distributed, remote-first team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity).</li> <li>Familiarity with Chainguard's open-source tools: Wolfi, apko, and melange.</li> <li>Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.</li> <li>Author of or maintainer of open-source projects.</li> <li>A non-traditional path into engineering. We value people who learned by building.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Location</strong></h3> <p>Remote. United States preferred; Also available to Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.</p> <h3><strong>Explore Our Work</strong></h3> <p>Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.</p> <p><a href="https://edu.chainguard.dev/" target="_blank">Chainguard Academy</a></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$205,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$231,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>We live and breathe our company values:</p> <ul> <li>We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.</li> <li>We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.</li> <li>We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.</li> <li>We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p>A few of the benefits we offer:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible & Remote-First Culture:</strong> Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.</li> <li><strong>Our Approach to Equity:</strong> Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).</li> <li><strong>100% Covered Health Insurance:</strong> We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.</li> <li><strong>∞ Flexible Time Off:</strong> Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.</li> <li><strong>18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:</strong> We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.</li> </ul> <p>If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.</p> <p>Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p> <p>By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://www.chainguard.dev/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a></span>.</p> <p>©2026 Chainguard. All Rights Reserved.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Say so clearly when a plan is at risk.</li> <li>Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and help the team raise the bar on how it uses them safely.</li> <li>Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, rather than stopping at the edge of your own repository.</li> <li>Keep the systems you touch healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.</li> <li>Write clearly and often. Design notes, pull request descriptions, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.</li> <li>High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you ask for help early when you are stuck.</li> <li>Judgment on trade-offs. You can explain why you chose speed here and rigor there, and you can change your mind when the data says to.</li> <li>A systems thinker. You reason about how a change moves through the build pipeline, the registry, and the customer's cluster, and you anticipate what breaks next.</li> <li>AI-native in how you work. You use agentic coding tools daily and can show what changed in your output because of them.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity. You can pick up a half-defined problem, decide what to build, and pivot when priorities shift.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in a systems language (Go preferred), API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS.</li> <li>Working knowledge of containers, container registries, the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad.</li> <li>Excellent written English and experience working on a distributed, remote-first team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity).</li> <li>Familiarity with Chainguard's open-source tools: Wolfi, apko, and melange.</li> <li>Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.</li> <li>Author of or contributor to open-source projects.</li> <li>A non-traditional path into engineering. We value people who learned by building.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Location</strong></h3> <p>Remote. United States preferred; Open to Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany.
