title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.</p> <p>You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.</li> <li>Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.</li> <li>Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.</li> <li>Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.</li> <li>Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.</li> <li>Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.</li> <li>Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.</li> <li>Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).</li> <li>Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.</li> <li>Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. title: Intermediate Backend Engineer - Code Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Intermediate Backend Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security</strong></h2> <h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in the code they write and the open source components they depend on.</p> <p>Your work connects dependency analysis, vulnerability detection, and automated remediation. You'll build parsing that tells the security analysis engine which libraries and frameworks a project uses, extend a service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, and develop hybrid analyzers that combine rule-based detection with artificial intelligence (AI) reasoning. You'll help evaluate how well those analyzers find real vulnerabilities and expand coverage of libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling.</p> <p>We use AI-assisted development tools in our daily work and expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop secure, well-tested, performant parsing for dependency manifests, lockfiles, and software bills of materials (SBOMs). Extend support for new package ecosystems and formats in the analysis engine and remediation service.</li> <li>Build and apply analyzers that combine deterministic analysis with AI-driven analysis, working with the team's technical leadership. Review their results and measure false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Create detection rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the test fixtures that prove they work.</li> <li>Contribute to packaging analyzers for continuous integration (CI) jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, reporting findings in GitLab's standard security report formats.</li> <li>Extend the automated remediation service, from running dependency updates in a sandbox to opening merge requests.</li> <li>Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. Identify technical debt that slows the team down, and propose and implement improvements.</li> <li>Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't.</li> <li>Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust. We use both, plus Ruby for remediation and Python for some analyzers, and value a willingness to work across them.</li> <li>A willingness to learn how vulnerabilities arise in code and the software supply chain, explore common vulnerability classes such as the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 and CWE, and apply static analysis to detect them. Deep expertise isn't required, and we'll help you develop it.</li> <li>The ability to organize your work and follow through on tasks independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems and propose iterative solutions.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience with containerized workflows and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or a willingness to learn them; package managers and dependency tooling such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo; web or mobile frameworks; parsing, abstract syntax trees (ASTs), program analysis, or detection rules; or evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data. We use Docker heavily.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing (SAST) and dependency scanning.</p> <p>We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p>Cloudflare engineering delivers multiple products and features to production at a tremendous pace, and depends on real time load balancing and long term capacity planning to do so with high performance and efficiency. The MAPS team is responsible for highly granular and large-scale resource usage instrumentation and measurement of Cloudflare's edge platform.  The team builds and runs data pipelines, as well as systems and libraries for measuring and collecting the data, and collaborates closely across the range of teams that build and run services on Cloudflare's global edge network to ensure consistent, complete, and correct attribution of all resource usage.</p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for highly motivated software engineers to join our MAPS team.  You’ll have a strong programming background with a deep understanding and experience developing and maintaining  distributed systems. You’ll need to be able to communicate effectively with engineers across the company to understand the behaviours of our systems and products in order to deliver tooling to meet their testing needs. title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval. Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing. Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams. Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results. Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware. Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases. Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs. Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data. Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial. 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments. Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable. Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis. Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior. Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature. Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable. Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with tools such as Ansys (Mechanical/LS-DYNA), MSC/NX Nastran, Altair (HyperMesh/OptiStruct/Radioss), or COMSOL is beneficial. Experience implementing user-defined material models and subroutines in Abaqus (UMAT/VUMAT/UMATHT), including the ability to write and debug Fortran, is desirable. Proficiency in scripting: Python for Abaqus automation and post-processing, and Python or MATLAB for closed-form and lower-order analysis methods used to size hardware and verify finite element results. Proficiency with 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks or CATIA, is desirable; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial. Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables. Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable. Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial. Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial. Experience with battery systems or electric propulsion systems is beneficial. Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail. title: Werkstudent Tech und Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description: Überblick Modern, inspirierend, vielfältig, begeisternd, so stellen wir uns die Zukunft vor. Die Zukunft des urbanen Wohnens und ein bisschen auch unsere eigene. Bis heute haben mehrere zehntausend Menschen in den von BelForm geformten Apartments ein außergewöhnliches Zuhause auf Zeit gefunden. Inzwischen steckt in jedem Projekt auch eine Menge Software. Mit technischem Anspruch und kurzen Wegen entwickeln wir Lösungen, die vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Einsatz bei Projektentwicklung, Vertrieb und Innenarchitektur reichen. Das Team verantwortet diese Systeme von der Idee bis zum laufenden Betrieb, Dokumentation und Absicherung eingeschlossen. Deine Rolle (15–20 Stunden pro Woche) Du unterstützt unser Tech-Team bei der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme und bringst dabei von Anfang an eigene technische Lösungen ein. Wir sind kein zehnköpfiges Entwicklerteam, das heißt viel Gestaltungsraum von Anfang an. Du bekommst Einblick in reale, produktiv genutzte Anwendungen vom Rechenkern bis zur Automatisierung und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass unsere internen Systeme zuverlässig laufen. Aufgabenspektrum Du arbeitest an Systemen, die im Tagesgeschäft benutzt werden, nicht an Übungsaufgaben. Weiterentwicklung unseres MCP-Servers (TypeScript, Node) Mitarbeit an Cockpit, unserer Python-Anwendung zur Immobilienkalkulation, vom Rechenkern bis zum automatisch erzeugten Dossier Entwicklung von Automatisierungen, die HubSpot, Asana und unsere Datenablage verbinden Auswertung von Nutzungsdaten und Ableitung von Verbesserungen für die Forschungsarbeit mit unseren Hochschulpartnern Dokumentation, Testing und Absicherung bestehender Systeme Abstimmung mit Projektbeteiligten im interdisziplinären Team (Projektentwicklung, Vertrieb, Innenarchitektur) Dein Profil Du bist eingeschriebener Student mit Technikbezug (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science o. Ä.), unabhängig vom Semester Erste Kenntnisse in Python oder TypeScript, idealerweise in beiden Sicherer Umgang mit Git und der Kommandozeile Interesse an KI-gestützter Entwicklung, wir arbeiten täglich mit Claude Code Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude an Teamarbeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse Erfahrung mit Azure oder Microsoft Graph ist kein Muss, das lernst du bei uns. Unser Angebot Arbeitsumfeld & Kultur: Ein wertschätzendes Miteinander in einem kollegialen Team aus kreativen und technischen Expert:innen, mit echter Augenhöhe und offener Kommunikation. Eine abwechslungsreiche Werkstudent:innen-Stelle mit echter Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Altbau-Büro mit Blick auf die Isar im Münchner Lehel. Flexibilität & Arbeitsweise: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen (mit Anteilen im Homeoffice und vor Ort im Büro). Einblick in reale Projekte ab Tag eins und sichtbarer Impact. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team und der Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen. Ausstattung & Benefits: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit hochwertiger Apple-Ausstattung und bester Lage mit optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung. Faire Vergütung von 16,00 € bis 18,00 € pro Stunde sowie attraktive Benefits, moderne Arbeitsmittel und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander. Team-Events und ein Unternehmen, in dem echte Zukunftsthemen bewegt werden. Haben wir deine Neugier geweckt? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und kurzem Anschreiben (Startdatum, verfügbarer Zeitraum). title: Cloud Platform Engineer – Connected Medical Devices
description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Cloud Platform Engineer to build and operate the cloud services layer behind our connected medical device platform on Microsoft Azure — from device telemetry ingress through storage, orchestration, and clinical system integration, under HIPAA and GDPR constraints. Key Responsibilities Design and operate the REST/HTTPS device-to-cloud ingestion path (TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS or token-based device auth) and manage the device certificate lifecycle Implement tiered storage and data pipelines across Data Lake Gen2, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and Data Factory / Stream Analytics, with US–EU data residency separation Enforce platform security: encryption, Key Vault, Entra ID access control, Private Link isolation, audit logging, and secure SDLC Translate HIPAA and GDPR obligations into concrete Azure controls and continuous compliance evidence; align with IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 where applicable Integrate clinical systems via Azure Health Data Services (FHIR R4, DICOM, HL7v2) and SMART on FHIR authorization Build licensing and entitlement services, and integrate payment providers (Stripe, Adyen) with reliable webhook and billing lifecycle handling Operate multi-tenant device fleet and user management, including device twins, configuration distribution, and role-based access for clinicians and patients Deliver signed OTA updates via Azure Device Update, with staged rollout, rollback, and a full audit trail Own Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep/Terraform), CI/CD, observability, cost management, and DR/BCP Required Qualifications 6+ years in cloud engineering, including 3+ years hands-on Azure in production Strong Node.js and TypeScript development experience for backend services and APIs, plus Python for data tooling Production experience with high-throughput REST/HTTPS APIs, TLS/mTLS, and certificate-based client authentication Demonstrated device-to-cloud IoT architecture at fleet scale Working knowledge of HIPAA and GDPR as engineering requirements, not just policy Infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and observability as everyday practice Preferred Qualifications Azure Authentication, Azure Data Storage, Azure Health Data Services / FHIR experience Background in regulated industries (medical devices, aerospace, automotive) — IEC 62304, ISO 13485, EU MDR Multi-region, multi-tenant SaaS with data residency constraints Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-500, AZ-220); What We Offer Work with direct impact on patient outcomes, a technically broad role across IoT and cloud, a quality-driven engineering culture, and competitive compensation and development support. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin or London</strong></p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-AbouttheRole">About the Role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.</p> <p>That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. </p> <p>Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.</p> <p>As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.</p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business</strong> across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.</li> <li><strong>Build for the whole Internet</strong> by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Make resilience a product principle.</strong> Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.</li> <li><strong>Drive an ACME-first customer experience</strong> that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with engineering</strong> on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations</strong> to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.</li> <li><strong>Own go-to-market strategy</strong> including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.</li> <li><strong>Represent the customer and the ecosystem</strong> in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.</li> <li><strong>Work across Cloudflare product teams</strong> including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.</li> <li><strong>Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero</strong> by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-DesirableSkills,KnowledgeandExperience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of product management experience</strong> building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products</strong> where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management</strong> including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.</li> <li><strong>Strong business judgment</strong> with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate in ambiguity</strong> and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency with engineering teams</strong> and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong written communication</strong> for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.</li> <li>Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.</li> <li>Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.</li> <li>Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.</li> <li>Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.</li> <li>Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate lifetimes.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.</li> <li>Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> title: Sr. Product Manager - Dashboards & Configuration (Integrity & Trust)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or London (Hybrid) </strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.</p> <p>Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.</p> <p>This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. title: (Senior) Sales / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: bonial hilft Dir dabei Zeit, Geld und Papier zu sparen. Wir sind ein digitaler Werbepartner für das Offline-Business. Wir unterstützen Händler:innen in deren Marketing-Aktivitäten und helfen dabei, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen. Würdest Du gern dazugehören und Teil des digitalen Wandels im Handel sein? bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und revolutioniert den Einzelhandel als führender "Drive to Store"-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich. Über unsere Plattformen " kaufDA " und " MeinProspekt " in Deutschland sowie “ Bonial “ in Frankreich verbinden wir täglich Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und schaffen dabei echten Mehrwert. Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen. Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Herzlich willkommen in unserem Team! Als (Senior) Sales / Key Account Manager (m/w/d) wirst Du Teil unseres Brands-Teams bei bonial und verantwortest den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts mit führenden Marken und Mediaagenturen. Du hast Spaß daran, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen, bestehende Beziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und überzeugst Entscheider von digitalen Marketinglösungen? Du bist gerne persönlich bei Kund:innen und Agenturen vor Ort, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und bewegst Dich sicher in der Media- und Agenturwelt? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen zu Marken und Mediaagenturen und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Kund:innen. Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Kund:innen und Budgets und entwickelst bestehende Accounts durch Cross- und Upselling kontinuierlich weiter. Du verstehst die Marketingziele Deiner Kund:innen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren internen Teams individuelle Media- und Kommunikationslösungen. Du präsentierst unsere Produkte und Konzepte, führst eigenständig Kundentermine, Pitches und Verhandlungen und begleitest den gesamten Sales-Prozess bis zum Abschluss. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Sales Pipeline, Forecasts und Umsatzziele und steuerst Deine Accounts eigenständig. Du repräsentierst bonial bei Kund:innen, Agenturen, Messen und Branchenevents und nutzt diese aktiv zum Aufbau und zur Pflege Deines Netzwerks. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Teams zusammen und bringst Markttrends, Kundenfeedback und neue Potenziale aktiv ein. Dein Profil: Sales-Erfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Media-, Digital- oder Advertising-Sales mit und hast idealerweise bereits eigenständig größere Kund:innen und Budgets verantwortet. Netzwerk: Du verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Marken, Mediaagenturen und relevanten Entscheider aus Marketing und Media. Hunter-Mentalität: Neukundenakquise macht Dir Spaß. Du gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Kund:innen zu, erkennst Geschäftspotenziale und entwickelst daraus langfristige Beziehungen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du trittst souverän und verbindlich auf und kannst Entscheider für Deine Ideen und Lösungen begeistern. Unternehmerisches Denken: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und zielorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Pipeline und Deine Ergebnisse. Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen internen Teams zusammen und entwickelst gemeinsam die beste Lösung für Deine Kund:innen. Reisebereitschaft: Persönliche Kund:innen- und Agenturtermine sowie Messen und Branchenevents gehören für Dich selbstverständlich zum Sales dazu. Sprachen & Tools: Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (C2), sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2) sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit PowerPoint und gängigen Sales- und Office-Tools runden Dein Profil ab. Was wir Dir bieten können: High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt. Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen. Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen. Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck. Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club. Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können. Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).* Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können. Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.* Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen. Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“ Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den Axel Springer Essentials . Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören! Besuche uns gerne auch auf unserer bonial_people Instagram Seite oder erfahre mehr über unsere bonial-Kultur unter bonial Medium . *gemäß unseren aktuell gültigen Betriebsvereinbarungen Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?</h2> <p>As a Staff Engineer, you will be a leader within the team and a strong contributor to the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Engineering Manager to develop the team and to devise technical strategy.</p> <p>Learn more about our engineering culture at <a href="http://intercom.engineering/">intercom.engineering</a></p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <p>As an experienced engineer you will:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. We scale to service requests from all our customers’ customers. We’re growing and so are they.</p> </li> <li> <p>Care about agility as much you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Even our biggest technical achievements roll out piece by piece, feature flagged out of sight.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, design and implementation. This role has a mix of both hands-on development as well as lead/architecture work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Play an active role in hiring, mentoring and career development of other engineers</p> </li> <li> <p>Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence</p> </li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Ideally, you’ve built an exciting SaaS product in your previous roles and loved the satisfaction that comes with knowing that people around the world are using something you’ve created</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant, demonstrated impact that your work has had on the product and/or the teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Perl etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)</p> </li> <li> <p>You will have experience with Distributed systems</p> </li> <li> <p>2+ years of experience as the primary technical leader for a team</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience collaborating directly with product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams and have a strong sense of product strategy.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate, Internal Communications, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Company</h2> <p>DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt are one global team building the future of local commerce. Our products power millions of interactions between consumers, merchants, and couriers every day, in cities around the world. Together, we’re combining global scale with deep local understanding to deliver what’s next. In this role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across all three brands.</p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>This role sits within the Global Internal Communications team, a high-impact group focused on engaging and connecting with DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt’s most important audience: our employees. This role will specifically support the International business (Deliveroo and Wolt) in Europe and the Middle East (EMEA).</p> <p>We are responsible for leading employee communications centred around our company-wide strategy, business goals, and financial results to ensure employees understand the company’s near- and long-term vision. This team works cross-functionally with key business stakeholders, touching every corner of the organisation.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Reporting to the Senior Manager, International Internal Communications, you will provide support across the Deliveroo and Wolt businesses including being the key internal comms point of contact for our EMEA country teams, working on change and issues communications, and partnering on content creation and relevant internationally focused projects. </p> <p>This role is ideal for someone with between 5-10 years of communications experience who is experienced in working with multiple stakeholders in fast paced but sometimes ambiguous environments. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager to translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees.</p> <h2>Day to day you’ll be:</h2> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Acting as the main internal comms point of contact for Deliveroo and Wolt (EMEA) country teams and regional communications managers</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Building and maintaining the community of internal communicators across the EMEA footprint, sharing best practice and editorial guidance and keeping consistency with international IC standards.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Supporting crisis and issues communications across EMEA, partnering with the Senior Director and Senior Managers </p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Providing change management comms support, partnering with the change management comms lead and people team on delivery.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Creating content to support company level events, such as all hands</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Leading on analytics and measurement for such events for the international internal comms team, working closely with the digital channels team.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Operating effectively as part of a global team partnering with the international business.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">You have a strong (5yrs +) track record of communications experience.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>You work well with multiple stakeholders across countries and brands, and can build and sustain a network of communicators.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>You thrive in fast paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, title: Senior Software Engineer - Egress (Go/Rust)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal </li> <li>London, UK </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.</p> <p>As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/">iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <p>You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network.</p> <p>You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more.</p> <p>Engineering teams at Cloudflare operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities.</p> <p>Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Make daily progress on assigned engineering tasks, such as designing systems, writing specs, writing title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren. Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird. Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich. Das wirst du konkret tun: Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung. Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten. KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann. Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen. Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann. Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen. Dein Profil Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br> fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br> network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br> unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br> taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br> on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br> experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. description: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong><em>Location</em></strong><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Come and join us in Hamburg or Berlin!</span></em></p> <p>Following Lyft’s acquisition of Freenow, we are looking for a Senior TPM to lead the technical workstreams that get us to Day 1 readiness — the period between signing and closing — and to set up the integration that follows. This is a high-stakes, high-visibility role reporting into the EU Tech Leader, with direct exposure to Freenow and Lyft leadership.</p> <p>You will be the single point of accountability for technical Day 1 readiness. That means making sure every employee, every office, and every critical system is ready to operate underFreenow by Lyft from the moment the deal closes — and that the integration stream is up and running the day after. You will also be the TPM accountable for the integration of future acquisitions Freenow makes.</p> <p>This is not a role for someone who wants to administer a project plan. You are expected to be technically credible, opinionated, and comfortable holding senior people to account across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, People, and Finance. You make decisions when others stall, escalate cleanly when you can’t, and keep the whole machine moving.</p> <hr> <h2><strong>YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Day 1 readiness. </strong>Own the end-to-end technical readiness plan between signing and closing. Define what “ready” means, track every workstream against it, and call the go/no-go on technical readiness for Day 1.</li> <li><strong>IT and workplace cutover. </strong>Coordinate identity and system access (SSO, IdP, mail, productivity suite, engineering tooling), hardware provisioning and re-imaging, and office setup including network, VPN, Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, and physical access. Make sure nobody shows up on Day 1 unable to work.</li> <li><strong>Security and compliance posture. </strong>Partner with Security and Legal to make sure the technical environment meets the new shareholder’s requirements on Day 1 — access controls, data handling, audit trails, vendor relationships.</li> <li><strong>Integration stream kickoff. </strong>Stand up the technical integration workstreams between Freenow and Lyft so they are running, staffed, and producing output from day one of the integration phase. Set the operating cadence, dependencies, and escalation paths.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional orchestration. </strong>Hold IT, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, Product Engineering, Data, Security, People, Legal, and Finance together on a single plan. Push hard on dependencies. Surface risks before they become incidents.</li> <li><strong>Executive communication. </strong>Produce the technical readiness narrative for Freenow leadership, Lyft leadership, and the integration steering committee.
