M&A timelines move, regulators ask questions, and things break. You stay structured and keep others structured.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to have: </p> <ul> <li>Previous experience inside a regulated business (mobility, fintech, payments) or working through a title: E-Commerce Developer – AI & Automation
description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Deine Mission bei uns Willst Du im E-Commerce nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern selbst die Hebel finden, die unseren Shop schneller, besser und erfolgreicher machen – mit KI, Automatisierung und sauberem Code? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Als E-Commerce Developer – AI & Automation (w/m/d) verantwortest Du die technische Weiterentwicklung unseres internationalen Shopify-PLUS-Shops über 11 Märkte – von Themes, Apps und Checkout bis zu Schnittstellen und automatisierten Workflows. Dabei denkst Du in Business-Ergebnissen: Was spart Zeit, was steigert die Conversion, was macht unsere Prozesse skalierbar? Ob Du aus der Shopify-Entwicklung, dem technischen E-Commerce oder der Automatisierung kommst: Die Position ist für Trainees bis Seniors offen – entscheidend sind Dein Drive, Deine Lernkurve und Dein Ownership. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen mit unseren Probiotika ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu schenken. Deine Aufgaben Du findest eigenständig die Stellen, an denen im E-Commerce Zeit, Umsatz oder Qualität verloren gehen, und löst sie mit KI, Automatisierung und Code – von der Idee bis zum Rollout. Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Prozesse mit n8n, Zapier und MCP und verbindest Shopify mit CRM, Accounting, Operations und Analytics. Du setzt KI täglich in Deiner Entwicklung ein, baust AI-Agenten und Tool-Integrationen und bringst funktionierende Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz. title: Social Media & Project Coordination (m/f/d), Fashion Week Focus
description: About us Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models. The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected. Your role You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners. title: Senior Post Producer (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Was macht ein Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) bei WPP Production?</strong></p> <p>Als Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich den gesamten Post-Produktionsprozess von Werbefilmen – von der Budgetierung und Ressourcenplanung für Schnitt, VFX, Grading und Audio-Finishing bis hin zur Einhaltung strenger Zeitpläne. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Agentur und Produktion führst Du souverän durch alle Abnahmeschleifen und stellt die fristgerechte sowie technisch einwandfreie Auslieferung der finalen Master sicher.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></p> <ul> <li>Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung, Führung und Nachkalkulation komplexer Budgets; Erfahrung in der Nachverhandlung von Change Requests und Scope-Erweiterungen</li> <li>Steuerung paralleler Projekte, Booking und Führung von Schnittplätzen, Grading-Suites, Tonstudios sowie In-House- & Freelance-Artisten unter hohem Zeitdruck</li> <li>Souveräne Führung von Abnahme-Sessions (Offline/Online-Abnahmen, Sound-Laydowns) mit Regie, Kreativdirektion, Agenturen und Endkunden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mehrjährige, einschlägige Erfahrung in der Post-Produktion von Werbefilmen (in einer Post-Production-Agency, Werbefilmproduktion oder Werbeagentur)</li> <li>Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Medienproduktion/Film, kaufmännische Ausbildung im Medienbereich oder vergleichbare fundierte Branchenerfahrung</li> <li>Exzellentes Verständnis der gesamten Post-Kette: Schnitt (Offline/Online), VFX/CGI, Color Grading, Motion Design, Mastering und Audio/Sounddesign</li> <li>Sicherer Umgang mit Post-Management-Tools (z. B. Frame.io) sowie solides Verständnis von NLEs und Suite-Standards (Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve)</li> <li>Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Master-Deliverables, Social-Media-Formatierungen (9:16, 4:5, 1:1), TV-Spezifikationen</li> <li>Hohe Belastbarkeit und Gelassenheit in engen Timelines, schnelle Lösungsfindung bei unvorhergesehenen Revisionsschleifen oder technischen Engpässen</li> <li>Feingefühl im Erwartungsmanagement zwischen kreativen Ansprüchen der Regie/Agentur und kommerziellen/zeitlichen Rahmenbedingungen</li> <li>Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (inkl. branchenspezifischer Fachbegriffe)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bieten wir </strong></p> <p>Bei uns findest du nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, das deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Entdecke unsere vielfältigen Vorteile:</p> <p> </p> <ol> <li>Arbeitskultur & Perspektiven:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Spannende, vielseitige Projekte in einem schnell wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen</li> <li>Offene Vertrauenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung</li> <li>Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche zur Talentförderung und Karriereentwicklung.</li> <li>Umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über unser globales WPP Netzwerk (Trainings, Webinare, E-Learning)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ol> <li>Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Hybrid Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten</li> <li>Cross-Border Working (europaweit) – Arbeite flexibel auch jenseits der Landesgrenzen</li> <li>Ein zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten beineiner eingetragenen Wohltätigkeitsorganisation</li> <li>Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für eine produktive Umgebung</li> <li>28 reguläre Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einem zusätzlichen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ol> <li>Gesundheit & Extras:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellness-Angebote (z.B. psychologische Beratung, Fitness, Prävention)</li> <li>Attraktives Corporate-Benefit-Programm mit Rabatten bei zahlreichen Marken</li> <li>Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge (inkl. vermögenswirksamer Leistungen / VWL)</li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen</li> <li>Beteiligung am Deutschland Ticket</li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Du würdest deine Fähigkeiten gerne in einer internationalen Agentur weiter ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und schnellstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here: <br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. </span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Inclusion and Impact </strong><br>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. title: Senior Growth Manager - France to Morocco
description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live. What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth. With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity. About the role As the Senior Growth Manager for the France-Morocco corridor, you'll drive LemFi's expansion within the Moroccan diaspora in one of our most critical markets. While the primary focus of your community-building will be in France, we are open to candidates based in France, the UK, or other European countries where LemFi currently operates. This is a growth role that requires you to be comfortable traveling to key diaspora hubs to build a physical community presence and drive high-leverage organic growth. You will direct influencer negotiations, manage external agencies and key community leaders, and execute grassroots field marketing. You'll spend 3 to 5 days every few weeks in a new city (primarily across France or other key European hubs), representing LemFi at events, building partnerships, rigorously tracking campaign performance, and driving user acquisition. You're embedded in the communities we serve, acting as both a strategist and a ground-level operator. You will work across paid channels, organic strategy, and local product teams to drive massive user acquisition in this market, while serving as the voice of the user. What you'll build and own Travel across France (and potentially other key European markets) 3 to 5 days every few weeks, establishing an on-the-ground presence in key cities. Attend community events, build and expand LemFi's community network with local Moroccan leaders and organizations, and grow relationships that build deep trust. Develop and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies tailored for the Moroccan diaspora communities in France and Europe. Own growth targets for assigned markets and optimize based on data and insights. Source, negotiate directly with, and manage France/Morocco-focused influencers, community leaders, and external agencies to drive scalable organic growth. Lead community-driven initiatives to build trust, awareness, and advocacy, and participate in local events, meetups, and forums. Build and maintain relationships with community leaders and grassroots partners, implementing tracking mechanisms for the exact customer acquisition cost of your activities. Your experience At least 5 years of experience in fast-paced environments with a background in growth, sales, marketing or similar. Proven ability to work against targets and deliver measurable results. You're motivated by ambitious goals and comfortable being measured against clear KPIs. Strong data-driven mindset. You interpret data, track performance and adjust strategies accordingly. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. You're a persuasive communicator who can influence partners and leaders. Entrepreneurial and tenacious. You take ownership, push through obstacles and find ways to win. Biased to action, you think critically and move quickly. Self-motivated and effective working independently and in remote environments. You're willing to travel extensively and work occasional weekends to support market growth. Nice to have Prior experience launching or scaling ventures in new markets. Deep understanding of African and diaspora community in Europe. You're culturally fluent and comfortable immersing yourself in new cultural environments. Background in fintech, payments or diaspora-focused products. Established network within diaspora communities. Why Join LemFi? Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this. At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions. You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Compensation: €65K – €75K • €65K – €75K Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Netherlands)
description: Our Vision & Products 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms. You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform. This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow. Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression. Here’s what you can expect: Key Responsibilities Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement. Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs. Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management. Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended. Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report. Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards. Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support. Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub . Your Qualifications Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning; Content moderation and AI guardrails : You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting. Legal/safety work experience : You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product; Collaborative mindset and communication : You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English; AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them; You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture; You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. ⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy. You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs. Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive. Why is our Vertical approach interesting? Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan. Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum. Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction. Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth. What will you do with us? You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing . The average sales cycle is 4-6 months , dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€ . At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects . We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless. We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Databases
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | Seattle, WA | London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.</p> <p>You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.</p> <p>Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.</li> <li>Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.</li> <li>Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.</li> <li>Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.</li> <li>Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.</li> <li>Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.</li> <li>You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.</li> <li>You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.</li> <li>You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.</li> <li>You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.</li> <li>You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.</li> <li>Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.</li> <li>You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.</li> <li>You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer - Applied AI & LLMs (x/f/m)
description: <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to join the DS & AI organization at Doctolib. This is a transversal force multiplier role operating across all AI teams: Clinical, Productivity, Phone Assistant and ASR. You will unblock teams, shape architecture decisions, and take on the deep technical work that requires senior ML judgment at scale, directly impacting the daily lives of 400,000 healthcare professionals and the health of 80 million patients. Building at Doctolib means delivering innovative products that measurably improve outcomes for care teams and patients alike.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Technical Strategy & Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own cross-team ML architecture decisions, from model selection to production deployment patterns and strategic build vs. buy decisions</li> <li>Define and drive adoption of rigorous evaluation frameworks across all AI teams, setting the standard for how Doctolib measures model and agentic performance</li> <li>Establish shared production infrastructure patterns for AI: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimization, and observability</li> <li>Lead the technical design of agentic solutions and define how product teams across Doctolib build on top of AI capabilities</li> <li>Elevate technical standards across the DS & AI org by influencing Staff and Senior ML Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, and practice propagation</li> <li>Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure safe rollout and meet EU regulatory expectations (GDPR, MDR, EU AI Act)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <p>Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p>You'll be a great fit if:</p> <ul> <li>You have 10+ years in ML/AI with 3+ years at Staff+ or Principal level leading complex, multi-team technical initiatives</li> <li>You have deep expertise in <strong>at least two</strong> of: clinical NLP, LLM fine-tuning and evaluation, automatic speech recognition, RAG systems, or reinforcement learning</li> <li>You are expert in Python, PyTorch/Transformers for training, and vLLM for inference with a track record deploying ML systems in production (AWS/GCP)</li> <li>You have a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent research experience)</li> <li>You have exceptional communication skills and are able to align diverse stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions</li> </ul> <p>Now it would be fantastic if you have:</p> <ul> <li>Publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL) or medical informatics venues</li> <li>Experience with EU healthcare regulations (GDPR, MDR, AI Act)</li> <li>Prior title: Sr. Account Executive Enterprise Sales
description: <h2>The Team + The Role</h2> <p>Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. The team partners with senior business and technology leaders to position Pendo as a critical platform for product experience, data, analytics, and digital transformation. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.</p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.</p> <p>This role is based in our Munich office.</p> <h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li><strong>New logo acquisition:</strong> Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise sales execution:</strong> Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.</li> <li><strong>Strategic deal leadership:</strong> Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.</li> <li><strong>Executive relationship building:</strong> Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Account planning:</strong> Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. You will partner with internal teams to bring the right expertise into each opportunity and create a strong, coordinated customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline and forecast discipline:</strong> Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management. You will keep opportunity data current, communicate deal progress clearly, and manage your business with structure and accountability.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <p>Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.</p> <p>You're a builder, not a maintainer.</p> <p>You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Account Executives don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.</p> <p>You're AI-curious - genuinely.</p> <p>You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.</p> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH.</li> <li>Experience selling into large, complex, matrixed organizations with multiple senior stakeholders and executive buyers.</li> <li>Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment, with the ability to operate with structure, urgency, and ownership.</li> <li>Background selling Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions.</li> <li>Passion for AI and technology, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way people work.</li> <li>Confident engagement style with C-level leaders, senior decision-makers, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven approach to account planning, pipeline management, and deal execution.</li> <li>Fluent German and professional English.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience selling into DAX 40 prospect accounts or similarly large strategic enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Experience positioning AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives.</li> </ul> <h2>About Pendo</h2> <p>Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.</p> <p><strong>Pendo Core Values:</strong> Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Robust, employer-backed social coverage paired with additional cash stipends, equity, and meaningful retirement and commute support.</p> <p><strong>EEOC:</strong> We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.</p> <p><strong>Accessibility:</strong> Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: ----- All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.</p> <p>We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.</p></div><p><span data-contrast="auto">Nozomi Networks is seeking an experienced, highly technical Senior Salesforce (SFDC) Developer to design, build, integrate, and support enterprise solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on engineering role for a developer with deep Salesforce expertise who can personally solve complex technical problems across Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, integrations, automation, data, security, Slack, and emerging AI technologies.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":80,"335559740":247}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The ideal candidate is a builder, not simply a Salesforce administrator or configuration specialist. This individual will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, write production-quality code, troubleshoot difficult issues, integrate Salesforce with enterprise platforms, and own solutions from architecture through deployment and production support.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":80,"335559740":247}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">A major focus of the role will be advancing Nozomi Networks' use of modern AI and agentic technologies, including Salesforce Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities, generative AI, Slack-based experiences, and AI-driven workflow automation.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":80,"335559740":247}"> </span></p> <div><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable solutions across Salesforce using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, Platform Events, and related technologies.</li> <li>Build AI-enabled solutions using Salesforce Agentforce, generative AI, LLM APIs, RAG, Prompt Builder, and intelligent automation.</li> <li>Develop Salesforce and Slack integrations, applications, bots, workflows, and AI-powered employee experiences.</li> <li>Design secure and reliable integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven architectures.</li> <li>Partner with GTM Architecture, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and other teams to align solutions with business processes and enterprise standards.</li> <li>Apply modern software engineering practices, including Git, Salesforce DX/CLI, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, monitoring, and documentation.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex production issues and continuously improve application performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.</li> </ul> <div><strong>To be successful in this opportunity, you will have:</strong></div> <ul> <li>7+ years of Salesforce platform experience with significant hands-on development responsibility.</li> <li>Advanced experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce data modeling, Flow, and automation.</li> <li>Strong experience designing REST APIs, enterprise integrations, and secure Salesforce solutions.</li> <li>Experience with Git-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, and production support.</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing AI-enabled applications using technologies such as Agentforce, generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, or semantic search.</li> <li>Strong ability to translate complex technical and business requirements into secure, scalable production solutions.</li> <li>Excellent technical documentation, troubleshooting, and communication skills.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred experience:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Slack development and integration, including APIs, applications, bots, workflows, OAuth, Events API, and webhooks.</li> <li>Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce.</li> <li>MuleSoft or comparable integration platforms.</li> <li>AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud services.</li> <li>Enterprise API architecture, identity and access management, and modern data platforms.</li> <li>Experience within a SaaS, cybersecurity, or fast-growing global technology organization.</li> <li>Relevant Salesforce certifications, including Platform Developer I/II or architecture-focused credentials.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Who we are and what we stand for:</strong></p> <p>Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT Cybersecurity. We’re always innovating and we hire the best at what they do to ensure our customers always have access to fast product enhancements, exceptional engineering support and rapid deployment across continents. If you like a challenge, and value integrity and customer success, we invite you to help Nozomi Networks build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.</p> <p>Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are part of our core beliefs, at Nozomi Networks. title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
description: Your Impact Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe. Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market. You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market. Your Tasks Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally Your Profile Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market Who Thrives Here You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market. Interview Process Intro call with our Chief of Staff Deep dive with our Head of Revenue Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. title: Data Engineer H/F
description: <p></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Capco France recherche des <strong>Data Engineers</strong> pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de plateformes et solutions data modernes, robustes et évolutives.</p> <p>Au sein de notre Practice <strong>Data & Analytics</strong>, vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation à fort impact, de la conception des architectures et pipelines de données jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur optimisation.</p> <h2><strong>Ce que vous ferez</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li>Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et évolutifs permettant d’ingérer, transformer et mettre à disposition des données issues de sources multiples.</li> <li>Participer à la conception et à l’évolution d’architectures data modernes, notamment dans des environnements Cloud, en tenant compte des enjeux de performance, de sécurité et de scalabilité.</li> <li>Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et l’observabilité des données grâce à des pratiques de tests, monitoring, documentation et automatisation.</li> <li>Collaborer avec les équipes Data, Cloud, Architecture et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions techniques performantes et maintenables.</li> <li>Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour accélérer le développement, les tests, la documentation ou l’analyse des incidents, avec revue humaine et respect des standards de sécurité et de gouvernance</li> </ul> <p></p> <h2><strong>Ce que nous recherchons</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Une expérience significative en <strong>Data Engineering, minimum 5 ans</strong>, avec une bonne maîtrise de Python et SQL et une expérience dans la conception de pipelines de données.</li> <li>Une expérience des technologies et architectures data modernes, ainsi que d’au moins un environnement Cloud tel qu’AWS, Azure ou GCP.</li> <li>Une bonne compréhension des problématiques de modélisation, transformation, qualité et gouvernance des données.</li> <li>Une capacité à collaborer avec des profils techniques et métiers, à résoudre des problématiques complexes et à communiquer clairement les choix techniques.</li> <li>Une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled appliqués au Data Engineering, avec une attention portée à la sécurité, à la qualité, à la traçabilité et à la validation humaine.</li> <li>Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes, réglementés et internationaux, avec une excellente communication en français et en anglais.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Atouts supplémentaires</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li>Une expérience avec des technologies telles que <strong>Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka ou dbt</strong>.</li> <li>Une pratique des principes <strong>DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code</strong> ou des approches d’automatisation appliquées aux plateformes data.</li> <li>Une expérience dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux, l’assurance ou plus largement les services financiers.</li> <li>Une connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, gouvernance, lineage et protection des données dans des environnements réglementés.</li> <li>Une expérience pratique de l’utilisation de Generative AI ou Agentic AI pour améliorer des workflows d’ingénierie, avec des mécanismes appropriés de revue, contrôle et traçabilité.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Capco ? </strong></h2> <p> </p> <p>Créé en 1998, Capco est un cabinet de conseil en management et en organisation spécialisé dans le secteur des services financiers, avec 34 bureaux répartis entre l’Amérique, l’Asie et l’Europe et regroupant 7 000 collaborateurs dont 160 à Paris.</p> <p>Notre offre conseil s’appuie sur trois grands domaines d’expertise : Business Consulting, Digital et Techonology</p> <p>Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :</p> <ul> <li>Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels</li> <li>Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise</li> <li>Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)</li> <li>Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance</li> <li>Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an</li> <li>Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique</li> <li>Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain : <ul> <li>#BeYourselfAtWork</li> <li>RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)</li> <li>Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM)
description: <p></p> <p><strong>Standort</strong>: Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) |<strong> Practice Area:</strong> Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | <strong>Anstellungsart</strong>: Unbefristet</p> <p><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft des Risiko- und Compliance-Managements – mit ServiceNow, intelligenten Workflows und innovativen Technologien.</strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Die Rolle</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p>Als Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM) bei Capco unterstützt du führende Banken, Asset Manager und Versicherungen bei der Konzeption, Transformation und Implementierung moderner Risiko- und Compliance-Prozesse auf Basis der ServiceNow-Plattform.</p> <p>Du berätst unsere Kunden an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Verantwortlichen aus Risikomanagement, Compliance und IT zukunftsfähige Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. Dabei analysierst du bestehende Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Strukturen, konzipierst skalierbare Zielarchitekturen und begleitest deren fachliche und technische Umsetzung.</p> <p>Du nutzt moderne Automatisierungsansätze und freigegebene KI-Technologien, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten, fundierte Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und die Qualität von Risiko- und Compliance-Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern. title: Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>New York, NY</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own data center delivery and the sourcing work that gets each site ready to operate. You'll take projects from vendor selection and contract negotiation through construction, infrastructure deployment, commissioning, and handover to operations.</p> <p>This role combines technical program management with hands-on commercial execution. You'll work with engineering, construction, procurement, and operations teams to ensure facilities, equipment, and site services are ready when they're needed, with clear accountability for schedule, cost, and quality.</p> <h1>What you'll do</h1> <h2>Deliver data centers</h2> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare across new builds and expansions, managing data center providers, general contractors, design consultants, commissioning agents, and compute integration partners.</li> <li>Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installation, white space fit-out, rack-level power, structured cabling, equipment staging and validation, and commissioning through operational acceptance.</li> <li>Maintain a delivery schedule that connects construction milestones, equipment arrivals, service activation, and deployment dependencies. Resolve field issues and drive recovery plans when commitments slip.</li> <li>Assess vendor and partner readiness before deployment, and coordinate handover with operations so acceptance criteria, documentation, and support responsibilities are clear.</li> </ul> <h2>Source site services and manage contracts</h2> <ul> <li>Own sourcing for the services each site needs to open and operate, including temporary power and water, security, waste management, and facilities support.</li> <li>Translate construction and operational requirements into scopes of work, supplier selections, and service start dates. Identify gaps early enough to prevent delays to site work.</li> <li>Negotiate regional and multi-site agreements, rate cards, service-level commitments, and change orders that new sites can use without restarting procurement.</li> <li>Hold suppliers accountable for delivery, service quality, and commercial commitments, coordinating utility and service-provider dependencies with construction and operations.</li> </ul> <h2>Manage the portfolio</h2> <ul> <li>Track budgets, forecasts, scope changes, and risks across concurrent projects. Give leadership concise updates on progress, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.</li> <li>Build repeatable site-readiness and delivery playbooks, including sourcing checklists, vendor qualification, milestone tracking, and handover requirements. Apply lessons from each build to the next.</li> <li>Ensure deployment activities meet applicable codes, safety standards, and security requirements in partnership with the responsible technical teams.</li> </ul> <h1>What you'll bring</h1> <ul> <li>7+ years in technical program management, construction management, or infrastructure delivery, including at least 5 years working on data center or high-density infrastructure projects.</li> <li>Direct experience managing data center providers or general contractors on behalf of an owner, including contract administration, schedule oversight, and scope changes.</li> <li>Hands-on sourcing experience for site services or indirect categories in multi-site industrial environments, including standing up services for a new site.</li> <li>Experience negotiating supplier agreements and rate cards across locations, with a practical understanding of how procurement lead times affect construction and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data center MEP systems, white space delivery, structured cabling, rack-level power distribution, and compute staging and integration.</li> <li>Experience managing substantial infrastructure budgets and competing dependencies across multiple projects.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical delivery issues and commercial tradeoffs to senior leadership.</li> <li>A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred experience</h1> <ul> <li>High-density GPU deployments and liquid cooling systems.</li> <li>Fast-track or modular data center construction.</li> <li>Utility coordination, security services contracting, and facilities management agreements.</li> <li>PMP or an equivalent project management credential.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 About the Role As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team. You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites , ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site. Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required. The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment. Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required. As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods. Your Key Responsibilities: System operations & technical support You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites. Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems. Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation. Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path. Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams. Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions. Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems. Maintenance & customer-site interventions You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions. Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention. Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures. Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions. Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities. Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements. The role involves business travel within France and internationally , with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems. User training & technical guidance You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs. Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities. Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces. Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance. Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation. Documentation & continuous improvement You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities. Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports. Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems. Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures. Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions. Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems. Requirements Education & experience Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field. The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities . Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred. Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued. Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage. Technical skills Required Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software. Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems. Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues. Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures. Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required. Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions. Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken , as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation. Willingness and ability to travel internationally. Nice to have Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics . Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment. Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems. Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python . Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment. Experience delivering technical training to users or operators. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one A team eager to collaborate and grow with you A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely) Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between. Process Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') Hiring Manager Interview (45') Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward) Meeting with the teams 2 reference check Offer (This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
