title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field. Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7 Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers Skills and Experience Required: BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements Proven team player, with the ability to: (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus Professional working language is in English. Start date: Immediately Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base , working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites , including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions , working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors , including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability , defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. What we're looking for Core experience Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States. EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk. Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery. Dit ben jij Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving. Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Project Leider Bouw
description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert. Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager. Waarom Monumental? Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je. Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: DNA Synthesis Platform Engineer
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems. DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time. You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance. This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems. We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes. What You'll Do Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies. Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups. Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development. Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform. Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability. Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems. Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering. Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization. Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production. Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development. What We're Looking For A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment. Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges. Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization. Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions. Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs. Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results. Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems. A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development. Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus. Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus. Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus. Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus. Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus. Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus. Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP We review applications on a rolling basis. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX (US), Washington, DC (US), London (UK)</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better internet and the Threat Application Services (TAS) team lives at the core of that effort. Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.<br><br>This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!</span></p> <p> </p></div><div style="text-align: start;" data-pm-slice="1 1 []" data-en-clipboard="true"> <p>As a Cato <strong>Senior Customer Success Manager</strong> for the French region, you will be a trusted advisor to our top customers from deployment and throughout their journey to renewal. title: Account Solutions Architect - Greenfield - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.</li> <li>Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.</li> <li>Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.</li> <li>Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.</li> <li>Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.</li> <li>Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.</li> <li>You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications <

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet. Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT. Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written). Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. Life at Nabla When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Team and Role</h3> <p>The Developer Productivity team builds internal tools and platforms that improve the velocity and developer experience of Cloudflare's engineering teams. We own developer productivity (code commit to production), developer insights and ADLC metrics, developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>This team is responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering. Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 4-12yrs</p> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth. High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. title: Lead AI Engineer
description: We are AI builders Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge. We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live. The role As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering. In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy. Requirements What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you. 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines) Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands Benefits We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Amsterdam ( preferred), or London <br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead<br><strong>Role type:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.</p> <p>This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.</p> <p>This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role combining:</p> <ul> <li>Deep power systems expertise</li> <li>Top-tier strategy problem solving</li> <li>Origination and senior client leadership</li> <li>Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes</li> <li>Team leadership and platform-building</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.</li> <li>Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.</li> <li>Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.</li> <li>Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Change & Platform Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.</li> <li>Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.</li> <li>Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.</li> <li>Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Origination & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor high-performing teams.</li> <li>Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.</p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy</li> <li>Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory</li> <li>Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.</li> <li>Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.</li> <li>Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.</li> <li>Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.</li> <li>Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.</li> <li>Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.</li> <li>Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.</li> <li>Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mindset</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.</li> <li>Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.</li> <li>Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why This Role Matters</strong></p> <p>Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.</p> <p>This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click <a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage - Consultant(e) en communication de Crise & Affaires Publiques
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Qui sommes-nous:</strong></p> <p>Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.</p> <p>En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.</p> <p>Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/"> bursonglobal.com</a> et suivez-nous sur <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">et Instagram</a>.</p> <p><strong>En savoir plus sur le rôle:</strong></p> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI" data-testid="job-section-description"> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI"> <div class="sc-dBueTE jxIZll" data-is-text-too-long="false" data-is-view-more="true"> <div class="sc-jHEWpz kgAAkN"> <p><em>Stage conventionné à compter de Septembre/ Octobre 2026.</em></p> <p>Vous intégrerez l’équipe Crise & Affaires Publiques de l’agence, composée d’une dizaine de [consultant.es], pour participer à leurs côtés à la gestion des affaires publiques (relations institutionnelles et lobbying) et des situations sensibles ou de crise, de clients de secteurs très divers.</p> <p>Vos missions sont également réparties entre les affaires publiques et la crise, parmi celles-ci (non exhaustif) :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Réalisation de veilles (institutionnelles, revue de presse, réseaux sociaux, sensibles)</p> </li> <li> <p>Cartographies de parties prenantes</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivi législatif (compte-rendu d’auditions, examen de textes, suivi du dépôt d’amendements)</p> </li> <li> <p>Recherche d’informations et notes de contexte et d’analyse</p> </li> <li> <p>Rédaction de notes de briefing et de préparation aux rendez-vous institutionnels ou presse</p> </li> <li> <p>Rédaction de scénarios d’exercices de crise ou pour des media trainings</p> </li> <li> <p>Participation à des exercices de crise</p> </li> <li> <p>Participation à des media trainings ou des formations de gestion et communication de crise</p> </li> <li> <p>Aide à la rédaction de plans d’atténuation des risques</p> </li> <li> <p>Aide à la préparation des réunions clients</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Notre engagement :</strong></p> <p>Nous vous offrons un stage professionnalisant au sein d’une équipe dynamique et experte. Vous serez pleinement intégré(e) à la vie de l’agence et bénéficierez d’un encadrement personnalisé :</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Suivi régulier :</strong> Points d’étape avec votre tuteur/tutrice pour évaluer votre progression et définir vos objectifs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Culture du feedback :</strong> Retours constructifs sur vos missions et vos réalisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Découverte du métier :</strong> Collaboration avec les consultants de l’équipe pour appréhender les différentes facettes de notre activité.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération et avantages :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Gratification : 750€/mois</p> </li> <li> <p>Télétravail possible et éligibilité à la prime de télétravail (10€/mois)</p> </li> <li> <p>Forfait mobilité durable (45,40€/mois)</p> </li> <li> <p>Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise (reste à charge de 3,70€)</p> </li> <li> <p>1 jour de RTT par mois</p> </li> <li> <p>Accès aux offres du comité d’entreprise (cinéma, culture, sport…)</p> </li> <li> <p>Prime de cooptation</p> </li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI" data-testid="job-section-experience"> <h4 commerce… <strong>Convention de stage obligatoire</strong></p> </li> <li> <p>Impliqué.e, curieux.se, autonome, sens du travail en équipe</p> </li> <li> <p>Capacités de rédaction analytique et synthétique</p> </li> <li> <p>Intérêt pour l’actualité politico-économique</p> </li> <li> <p>Intérêt pour les institutions françaises, le processus législatif (navette parlementaire, prérogatives et fonctionnement du Parlement) et l’actualité gouvernementale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Intérêt pour découvrir des secteurs et des missions éclectiques</p> </li> <li> <p>Anglais lu, écrit et parlé (plusieurs missions peuvent être en anglais)</p> </li> </ul> <p>Nous recherchons avant tout des profils divers pour constituer une équipe complémentaire. La principale qualité requise est l’envie d’apprendre et de se professionnaliser.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Déroulement des entretiens : </strong></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI" data-testid="job-section-process"> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI"> <div class="sc-dBueTE jBdbxD" data-is-text-too-long="false" data-is-view-more="false"> <div class="sc-jHEWpz kgAAkN"> <p><strong>Le processus de recrutement (on ne te fera pas passer 10 entretiens, promis) :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Envoie-nous ton CV (et une lettre de motivation si tu as envie de nous en dire plus sur toi).</p> </li> <li> <p>Si ton profil nous intéresse, on te contactera pour un premier échange téléphonique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensuite, tu rencontreras deux de nos consultants pour un entretien et la réalisation d’un cas pratique (histoire de voir comment tu réagis face à une situation concrète).</p> </li> <li> <p>Le débriefing de cet exercice se fera directement pendant l’entretien.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Rejoignez-nous !</strong></p> <p>Si vous êtes passionné(e) par la communication et souhaitez développer vos compétences au sein d’une agence de référence, envoyez-nous votre candidature (CV).</p> <p>Pour en savoir plus sur Burson :[[<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/france" target="_blank">https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/france</a>]</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>#LIAB1,20</strong></p> <p><strong>Votre place est chez Burson :</strong></p> <p>Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on.
